offers.name: CCode Free Plan
offers.value: $10 of usage a month on six open models, no card
offers.summary: CCode is a terminal coding agent that works with many models. Its free plan gives $10 of usage a month on six open models (including Qwen 4 Max, GLM 5.3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash), with no card.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up with GitHub, or connects GitHub to an email account. Each GitHub account unlocks the free plan for one CCode account.
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up with GitHub, or connect GitHub to an email account, at https://ccode.si.
offers.caveats: Free usage is limited to the six open models listed on the site. A CCode plan is optional; you can also bring your own keys.

offers.name: Searlo free credits
offers.value: 3,000 free credits on signup, no card, valid 1 year for new users
offers.summary: Searlo is a SERP API that returns live web, news, maps, shopping and other Google results as JSON, with an MCP server. Signing up gives a key with 3,000 free credits and no card.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up for an API key
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at https://dashboard.searlo.tech; the dashboard gives you a key with 3,000 free credits, with no card and no plan to pick.
offers.caveats: The 3,000 credits are a one-time grant, not a monthly allowance. New users: 1-year validity. Legacy users: unlimited credits. Free credits work on every search type, with the same rate limits as a paid pack.

offers.name: AIsa for Startups
offers.value: $10,000, $30,000 or $50,000 in AIsa data balance for 12 months, across three application tiers, with $2,000,000 total for 200 AI-agent startups
offers.summary: AIsa sells data APIs for AI agents on one key. AIsa for Startups gives selected startups $10,000 to $50,000 in data balance for 12 months, with a $2,000,000 cap for 200 startups.
offers.who_qualifies: Startups building AI agents, founded less than 5 years ago, raised less than $10M, with a live company-domain website and a company email; not resellers, and with no AIsa account or under $1,000 in paid top-ups. Build: raised under $1M or self-funded, with a product people can use today. Launch: raised $1M to $5M, with a live product and users. Scale: raised $5M to $10M or referred by a partner investor, with data at the core of the product.
offers.how_to_claim: Apply on https://aisa.one/startups, in about 2 minutes, using a company-domain email.
offers.caveats: The official page brands this as AIsa for Startups; the company's own announcement calls it Ignition. The balance covers data APIs in the AIsa catalog at listed rates, not LLMs, Similarweb or Semrush. AIsa places you in a tier after you apply. A separate Starter plan gives $1 of free balance each month with no card, which is not this program.

offers.name: Crawl4AI Cloud free plan
offers.value: 1,000 free credits every month, no card (up to 10,000 pages)
offers.summary: Crawl4AI Cloud is the official hosted web crawling API from the team behind the open-source Crawl4AI crawler. The free plan gives 1,000 credits a month with no credit card, enough for up to 10,000 plain pages.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up and verifies their email. No credit card is required.
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up for Crawl4AI Cloud and verify your email to receive 1,000 free credits every month. The official page also offers 20 free credits with no signup.
offers.caveats: The free plan is limited to 10 requests a minute and 2 at a time. A plain page costs 0.1 credit, a real browser page 0.5, and a hard site 2, so the plan covers fewer than 10,000 pages when those higher-cost actions are used. Failed calls are free.

offers.name: Tabstack 10,000 free credits
offers.value: 10,000 free credits on signup, no card
offers.summary: Tabstack, built by Mozilla, is a web API that lets AI models research, extract and automate tasks on live web pages. Every new account gets 10,000 free credits with no card required.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who creates a new Tabstack account. No credit card is required.
offers.how_to_claim: Create a new Tabstack account on the official site. The 10,000 free credits are included with every new account and no card is required.
offers.caveats: The 10,000 credits are a one-time signup amount, not a monthly free plan. After they are used, paid plans start at $10 a month. Credit costs include 10 credits for Extract Markdown, 50 for Extract JSON, 100 for Generate or Automate, 250 for Research Fast, and 350 for Research Balanced.

offers.name: Sentry for Education
offers.value: Free plan for 1 year: unlimited team members, 50K errors, 5GB logs, 5M spans, 500 replays, 1 cron monitor, 1GB attachments, and $20 Seer credits per month
offers.summary: Sentry is an error and performance monitoring platform. Students, teachers and university researchers get a free education plan for one year.
offers.who_qualifies: Students, teachers and university researchers. Students become eligible through the GitHub Student Developer Pack, then activate on the Sentry for Education page.
offers.how_to_claim: Students: get the GitHub Student Developer Pack, then activate the free education account on https://sentry.io/for/education/. Teachers and university researchers can also use Sentry for free; Sentry's help center says faculty should verify a GitHub Education teacher account or apply for a sponsored account, and to use the same education page if they have issues.
offers.caveats: The education plan lasts 1 year from the start date and is not renewed; Sentry's help center says the org then moves to the free Developer plan. Student eligibility requires the GitHub Student Developer Pack. The education page quote of $20 Seer credits per month differs from the Sentry for Good list, which quotes 1 Seer active contributor seat plus extra quotas (metrics, uptime, profiling and size analysis).

offers.name: TinyFish Student Program
offers.value: $35 wallet credit at signup with an eligible academic email
offers.summary: TinyFish offers web search, fetch, agent and browser primitives for AI agents. Currently enrolled students with an eligible academic email get $35 in wallet credit automatically at signup, plus a bounty board with gift cards for approved builds.
offers.who_qualifies: Currently enrolled students, any school or country. The $35 credit is automatic only with an eligible academic email domain listed in the FAQs; otherwise email community@tinyfish.ai.
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at agent.tinyfish.ai with an eligible academic email to get the $35 wallet credit automatically. Then sign in at tinybounties.com for the bounty board, submissions and rewards. If your academic email is not covered, email community@tinyfish.ai.
offers.caveats: The $35 credit is automatic only with an eligible academic email domain (US .edu and listed country suffixes and university domains in the FAQs). If your domain is not covered, email community@tinyfish.ai. How long the wallet credit lasts is not stated. Bounty rewards are gift cards, not cash, and submissions ask you to post the work on X and LinkedIn.

offers.name: Heroku for Students
offers.value: $13 per month in Heroku platform credits for 24 months ($312 total)
offers.summary: Heroku is a cloud platform for building, deploying and scaling apps, including managed data services and AI inference. Students in the GitHub Student Developer Pack who are 18 or older get $13 per month in platform credits for 24 months, totaling $312.
offers.who_qualifies: Students 18 or older who are enrolled in the GitHub Student Developer Pack. Personal Heroku accounts only; Teams are not eligible. Prior participants of the current program (from October 2022) cannot reapply.
offers.how_to_claim: Enroll in the GitHub Student Developer Pack and open the Heroku offer, sign up or log in to a personal Heroku account, add a credit or debit card, and apply for Heroku for GitHub Students.
offers.caveats: A valid credit or debit card is required. Credits apply only to Heroku products such as Dynos, Heroku Postgres, Heroku Key-Value Store and Heroku CI, not paid third-party add-ons. Unused monthly credits do not roll over. Credits begin on the first day of the approval month, so applying late in the month uses that month's $13. Heroku Help says the $13 monthly amount is deducted from the $312 allocation each month whether it is used or not. Credits cannot be moved to another account. A stray line on heroku.com/students mentions 12 months; the dedicated offer page, FAQ and help article all say 24 months.

offers.name: Cerebellum Labs Free Credits
offers.value: $5 in free credits to start. No expiry.
offers.summary: Cerebellum Labs serves custom open-weight models behind an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, billed per token, with nothing charged while idle. New accounts start with $5 in free credits that never expire.
offers.who_qualifies: New accounts; no other eligibility is stated
offers.how_to_claim: Create an account at cerebellumlabs.ai; new accounts start with $5 in free credits.
offers.caveats: Credits are prepaid and spent on per-token inference. Idle time, storage and GPUs are not charged. Extra credits can be added by card and also never expire. A card is not stated as required to claim the $5.

offers.name: Wiro for Students
offers.value: $200 in Wiro credits, valid 12 months from the day they land
offers.summary: Wiro is an API platform with one key for 1000+ image, video, audio, 3D and language models. Enrolled students get a one-time $200 credit grant, valid 12 months, with no card required.
offers.who_qualifies: Currently enrolled higher-education students worldwide with a school-issued email on their Wiro account. Teaching assistants, researchers and bootcamp students are reviewed case by case.
offers.how_to_claim: Create a Wiro account with your school-issued email, then press Apply in the app and send one message with your university, programme and year, and what you want to build. Wiro reviews by hand, usually within two business days, and issues a personal, single-use coupon code tied to that account. Redeem the code to add the $200. No card is required.
offers.caveats: Credits are a one-time grant, valid 12 months from the day they land, with no auto-renewal. For learning and personal projects only, not client work, resale or running a business. One grant per person. Approval is manual, usually within two business days. A school-issued email must already be on the Wiro account; personal Gmail or Outlook is not enough on its own.

offers.name: Cloudflare for Students
offers.value: Workers Paid plan base fee ($5/mo) waived for 12 months, with 10M requests/month, 20M logs/month and 6,000 build minutes/month included
offers.summary: Cloudflare runs a developer platform for serverless apps. Its student program waives the Workers Paid base fee for one year for eligible US students.
offers.who_qualifies: Students in the US, 18 or older, with a verified .edu billing email.
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up, add a payment method with your .edu billing email, add the Workers Paid plan; the fee is waived for 12 months.
offers.caveats: Heads up: you need a card on file and must add the Workers Paid plan; the $5 a month fee is waived for 12 months. US .edu students only. Usage above the allotments is billed. Reverts to the free plan after 12 months.

offers.name: Thunder Compute Student Program
offers.value: $20 in free GPU credit, usable on A6000 or L40 GPUs
offers.summary: Thunder Compute rents cloud GPUs. Its student program adds $20 of credit automatically for US university students.
offers.who_qualifies: Students enrolled at US universities who sign up with a university email.
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up with a student email; credit is added automatically, no application.
offers.caveats: US universities only. After the credit runs out, normal pay-as-you-go billing applies.

offers.name: Langfuse Fast Grant for Research & Education
offers.value: US $200 monthly credit towards any Langfuse Cloud plan, with unlimited collaborators
offers.summary: Langfuse is an open-source LLM observability and evaluation platform. Its research and education program gives eligible academics and students a monthly Cloud credit on top of the free plan (50k units a month) and MIT-licensed self-hosting.
offers.who_qualifies: Self-certified researchers, academics, students and teachers who are enrolled, employed or formally affiliated with an accredited academic or research institution, or whose work is intended for peer-review publication. Workload must be non-commercial. Larger research grants by email to research@langfuse.com for university labs and student teams.
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up to Langfuse Cloud with an academic address, fill out the Fast Grant form on the page, receive a coupon code and apply it when upgrading to Core or Pro.
offers.caveats: Credits reset monthly and do not roll over. Workload must be non-commercial; startups are pointed to a separate Startups Program.

offers.name: Super for Startups
offers.value: $5,000 in confidential compute credits, valid 12 months, no equity
offers.summary: Super Protocol sells confidential computing for AI, with hardware-sealed GPU workloads. Its startup program gives eligible early-stage teams $5,000 in credits for confidential GPU-hours, Confidential Router tokens and Marketplace apps, plus an architecture session.
offers.who_qualifies: Pre-seed to Series A teams building AI on sensitive data (patient records, financial transactions, legal documents, personal data or proprietary models), new to Super credits, willing to share feedback.
offers.how_to_claim: Apply on the official page (about five minutes: who you are and what you are building). You hear back within two business days. If accepted, credits land in your console, Router access opens, and they book an architecture session.

offers.name: Exa for Startups
offers.value: $2,500 in Exa credits on approval, plus a 1:1 reload match of up to $5,000 more (up to $7,500 combined, or $15,000 for partner programs)
offers.summary: Exa is a search and web-data API for AI agents. Its startup program gives eligible AI startups $2,500 in starting credits on approval and matches every dollar reloaded, up to $5,000.
offers.who_qualifies: Startups from pre-seed through Series A that are building with AI and are new to Exa's paid plans. Exa decides eligibility, one per company.
offers.how_to_claim: Apply with the form on exa.ai/startups (about two minutes: how you are backed and what you are building). Most applications are checked automatically within minutes. Accelerator, incubator or investor partners give a partner code to enter in the form's partner code field.
offers.caveats: The Startup Program Terms cap the combined total at $7,500, or $15,000 for partner programs; the startups page headline says up to $15,000 and that amounts vary by partner program. Starting credits expire 6 months after issue. Matched credits must be unlocked within 12 months of enrollment and expire 12 months after enrollment. Credits cover Exa API usage only (Search, Contents, Agent, Websets, Monitors, Snapshot), have no cash value, are non-transferable and non-refundable, and cannot be combined with other offers, including the standard credit on the pricing page. Zero data retention and HIPAA are not included. Credits are forfeited if the account is terminated and may be revoked for abuse; Exa may change or end the program at any time, but credits already issued stay usable until they expire. The page also mentions a separate $1,000 education grant for students and researchers.

offers.name: Telnyx Pretrial $25 AI credits
offers.value: $25 in AI credits with no credit card, plus one US local phone number. Developer docs say Pretrial accounts cannot use Inference or create AI Assistants and that the credits can be used with Cloud Storage.
offers.summary: Telnyx is a communications and AI infrastructure company. New Pretrial accounts get $25 in AI credits with no card or payment setup, plus one US local phone number.
offers.who_qualifies: New Telnyx Pretrial accounts signed up by email
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at https://telnyx.com/sign-up with an email address and open the magic link to log in. The $25 credit is applied automatically.
offers.caveats: Official pages disagree on what the credit can buy. The help center says it covers the Telnyx AI product suite, including Inference and AI Assistants. The developer Privileges and Limitations page (https://developers.telnyx.com/docs/account-setup/levels-and-capabilities/pretrial) says Pretrial accounts cannot use Inference or create AI Assistants, and that Pretrial AI credits can be used with Cloud Storage. Upgrading to a Trial account replaces the $25 AI credit with a $5 general credit. Pretrial accounts cannot add funds. The help center says the account shows days left to use the credit, but no duration is stated. Developer docs say the included US number is reclaimed within 30 days if the account has not upgraded.

offers.name: Infomaniak AI Services 1M free credits
offers.value: 1 million free credits for one month (the guide says each request consumes one credit or LLM token), then pay as you go
offers.summary: Infomaniak is a Swiss cloud provider whose AI Services run open-source models (LLM, speech transcription, image generation) with an OpenAI-compatible API, processed in Switzerland. One million free credits let you test the service for one month.
offers.who_qualifies: Developers and the general public with an Infomaniak Organization; the legal representative, administrators, and collaborators with technical rights can use AI Services.
offers.how_to_claim: Create an Infomaniak account and open AI Services in the Infomaniak Manager. For API access, create an API token. A credit card is required to start using the API.
offers.caveats: A credit card is required to start using the API; usage is billed after the free credits. The official pages do not state a cash value for the 1 million credits, and the guide's wording equates a credit with an LLM token.

offers.name: pyannoteAI Startup Program
offers.value: Up to $3,000 in API credits valid for 12 months, plus a solution-engineer onboarding session, guided support, early access to new models, and market exposure.
offers.summary: pyannoteAI offers speaker diarization and speaker intelligence APIs for voice products. The startup program gives early-stage Voice AI teams up to $3,000 in API credits valid for 12 months, plus onboarding with a solution engineer.
offers.who_qualifies: Pre-seed, seed, or Series B Voice AI startups with fewer than 25 employees, a product in production or launching within 6 months, and voice as the core of the offer. Not open to agencies, consultancies, existing pyannoteAI customers including enterprise contracts, short-term or one-off projects, or more than one application per company.
offers.how_to_claim: Apply on the form at https://www.pyannote.ai/startup-program (about five minutes), then join a 20-minute call with a solution architect. Once accepted, credits are activated and a solution engineer schedules the onboarding session. The official page does not mention a promo code.
offers.caveats: Credits are up to $3,000 and are valid for 12 months. Acceptance requires an application and a call. Existing pyannoteAI customers cannot apply. A card requirement is not stated.

offers.name: Kiro for Students
offers.value: 1,000 Kiro credits per month, free for one year
offers.summary: Kiro is an AI coding IDE. Verified students at listed universities who are at least 18 get 1,000 credits a month free for one year, with no credit card required.
offers.who_qualifies: Eligible university students at schools on Kiro's published list who are at least 18 years old; verified through SheerID (name, date of birth, university, and sometimes a student ID or enrollment letter).
offers.how_to_claim: Sign in to Kiro with an individual Google, GitHub, or AWS Builder ID account, then go to the Students section in Settings, select your university, and complete SheerID verification. If your university is not listed, join the interest form on the same page.
offers.caveats: Credits do not roll over month to month, and add-on credits are not available. After one year the account is downgraded to the Kiro free tier. You must be at least 18. The Kiro account does not need a university email, but SheerID verification does.

offers.name: Codex for Students
offers.value: $100 in ChatGPT credits for use in Codex, expiring 12 months after the grant
offers.summary: OpenAI's student offer gives verified US and Canada university students $100 in ChatGPT credits to use in Codex. These are ChatGPT credits, not API credits.
offers.who_qualifies: Current students enrolled at degree-granting universities in the United States or Canada and residing in the United States or Canada when claiming; one offer per student, subject to verification. A ChatGPT Free, Go, Plus, or Pro account is required.
offers.how_to_claim: Start the verification flow from the claim page at https://chatgpt.com/codex/offers/students with a ChatGPT account (Free, Go, Plus or Pro) and a university email. Credits are added automatically after verification.
offers.caveats: These are ChatGPT credits for use in Codex, not API credits. After the offer is applied, the usage page shows 2,500 credits, equivalent to $100. No program end date is stated; the credits themselves expire 12 months after the grant date.

offers.name: v0 for Students
offers.value: $20 credits per month for free for 1 year
offers.summary: v0 is Vercel's AI app builder. Verified students at listed active schools get $20 credits per month free for 1 year.
offers.who_qualifies: Currently enrolled students at one of the active schools listed on the official page (Stanford, Harvard, MIT, Princeton, UC Berkeley, San Francisco State, Arizona State, Georgia Institute of Technology, University of Waterloo, New York University, Grand Canyon University, Northwestern, University of Washington, Cornell, and University of Southern California) who verify with a valid student email.
offers.how_to_claim: Open https://v0.app/students and use Verify student status with a valid student email for an active school.
offers.caveats: The program is limited to the active schools listed on the official page. One FAQ calls them US-based universities, but the list includes the University of Waterloo. No program end date is stated; benefits last 1 year after verification. The official FAQ does not name a plan tier.

offers.name: AMD Token Lab free API access
offers.value: 10 complimentary Token Lab points with 30 day validity, for API access to open models
offers.summary: Eligible members of the free AMD AI Developer Program get 10 complimentary Token Lab points, valid for 30 days after activation, for API access to open models such as DeepSeek V4, GLM-5.3, Qwen3.8, Gemma 4 and others, running on AMD GPUs.
offers.who_qualifies: Eligible members of the AMD AI Developer Program, which is free to join
offers.how_to_claim: Join the AMD AI Developer Program at https://developer.amd.com/ai-developer-program/, then visit Token Lab at https://notebooks.amd.com/tokenlab. No credit request form is needed. Sign in to access your API key, available models, usage rates and remaining points.
offers.caveats: Token Lab usage is measured in points; consumption depends on the selected model and its usage rate on the platform. tokenlab.amd.com currently fails; the official Token Lab link is https://notebooks.amd.com/tokenlab, which presents a sign-in page. The source post's 'about 20 requests/min' figure is not on the official pages. Token Lab needs no credit request form, unlike the program's AMD Developer Cloud and Fireworks AI introductory credits. Card requirement is not stated.

offers.name: Lovable Free Plan
offers.value: Free plan: daily grant of 5 build credits (up to 30 a month), 20 Cloud credits a month, and 4 credits for AI features built into user apps
offers.summary: Lovable is an AI software engineer that builds web apps from chat. The free plan gives a daily grant of 5 build credits (up to 30 a month), monthly grants of 20 Cloud credits, and 4 credits for AI features built into user apps.
offers.who_qualifies: No eligibility limits are stated on the official pricing page. Starting to build on Lovable is free.
offers.how_to_claim: Start on the free plan at https://lovable.dev/pricing. The official page does not mention a promo code.
offers.caveats: Daily build credits expire at the end of each day and do not roll over. The daily grant is capped at 30 build credits a month. A card requirement is not stated.

offers.name: AI Gateway free tier $5 monthly credit
offers.value: $5 /month included on every Vercel team account, limited to Free Tier eligible models
offers.summary: Vercel AI Gateway is one API and one key for models from many providers, at provider list rates with no markup. Every Vercel team account gets a free tier with $5 of credit each month on Free Tier eligible models, with lower rate limits, until the team buys credits.
offers.who_qualifies: Every Vercel team account that has not purchased AI Gateway Credits. A valid payment method is required to use free credits. A Vercel account is needed to create the key and manage billing; a Vercel project or deployment is not.
offers.how_to_claim: Create a Vercel account, then make your first AI Gateway request. Free credits start then. Use a Free Tier eligible model from https://vercel.com/ai-gateway/models?freeTier=true
offers.caveats: The free tier covers only Free Tier eligible models, with lower per-model rate limits. Buying any AI Gateway Credits moves the team to the paid tier and the monthly free credit no longer applies. BYOK is not available on the free tier. This is not the v0 $5 one-time credit, the Reflection Beam free model, or Vercel for Startups.

offers.name: E2B Hobby plan free credits
offers.value: One-time $100 in usage credits on the free Hobby plan, no credit card required
offers.summary: E2B is a cloud sandbox platform that gives AI agents isolated machines to run code. The Hobby plan is $0 per month with a one-time $100 in usage credits, up to 10 concurrent sandboxes and 1 hour per sandbox session.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone can sign up for the Hobby plan; the official pricing page states no further eligibility limits
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up from the pricing page with Start for Free; no credit card required
offers.caveats: The $100 is a one-time usage credit. Usage beyond that is charged per second of running sandbox time. Sessions are limited to 1 hour. At most 10 concurrent sandboxes. Default CPU and RAM only. The page does not say whether the $100 credit itself expires.

offers.name: Future AGI Startup Program
offers.value: $6,000 platform credits for one year plus 6 months of Pro
offers.summary: Future AGI is a platform for simulating, evaluating, guarding, and monitoring AI agents. Its startup program gives eligible startups $6,000 in platform credits for one year and 6 months of the Pro plan, plus engineering Slack and weekly founder office hours.
offers.who_qualifies: Companies with less than $10M in total funding raised, less than 5 years old, building a product that uses LLMs or AI agents, with a live product or working prototype. Solo founders can apply.
offers.how_to_claim: Apply on https://futureagi.com/startups/ using the application form. No credit card is required. The page says most applications are reviewed within 48 hours, and credits are activated the same day after approval.
offers.caveats:
Applications are reviewed, most within 48 hours, and credits are activated the same day after approval.

When the credits run out, you move to standard pricing starting at $99/month. The page also mentions extended discounts for program alumni, and says you can cancel anytime.

offers.name: Runloop Free Pro Trial
offers.value: $50 usage credit with full Pro feature access for new accounts, subject to trial sandbox limits until upgrade
offers.summary: Runloop is a sandbox cloud for AI coding agents. New accounts get a free Pro trial with a $50 usage credit and no credit card required. There is no automatic charge when the trial ends.
offers.who_qualifies: New accounts. No credit card is required.
offers.how_to_claim: Start the free Pro trial from https://runloop.ai/pricing, or sign up at https://platform.runloop.ai/auth/register. No credit card is required.
offers.caveats:
The $50 credit has no stated calendar expiry. The trial ends when the usage limit is reached, and there is no automatic charge.

Until you upgrade, trial accounts are capped at 3 running devboxes, 5 blueprints, 10 snapshots and 3 objects.

At the usage limit you are prompted to switch to the Basic plan (a free subscription with usage billed for what you use) or upgrade to paid Pro ($250 per month plus usage) or Enterprise.

The Basic plan separately lists 100 GB of free storage and a first month free; that is not the Pro trial offer. Suspended devboxes do not accrue compute or memory charges, but storage charges continue.

offers.name: New Relic for Startups
offers.value: Full New Relic platform free for accepted startups: 5 users, generous monthly data ingest (amount not stated), and every AI feature, plus a launch-day engineer, office hours, quarterly architecture reviews, and war room sessions.
offers.summary: New Relic is an observability platform with APM, logs, and AI monitoring. Its startup program gives accepted early-stage startups the full platform free, with 5 users, generous monthly data ingest, and every AI feature, plus launch support, office hours, and architecture reviews.
offers.who_qualifies: Qualified Series A and earlier startups. Official launch materials say the program is open to vetted early-stage startups, through a VC or accelerator referral or directly. New Relic may accept or reject any application.
offers.how_to_claim: The launch post says to sign up at https://newrelic.com/startups, but that address now redirects to the general platform page and no signup form is shown. You must accept the New Relic Agreement and be accepted into the program. Terms are at https://newrelic.com/termsandconditions/startups-terms-and-conditions.
offers.caveats:
The monthly data ingest amount, how long the free access lasts, and eligibility are not stated on an official page. The program page at https://newrelic.com/startups now redirects to the general platform page. The public free tier (100 GB and 1 user) is a separate offer, not the program's ingest amount.

Eligibility and the extra benefits come from the 23 Jun 2026 launch post (https://newrelic.com/blog/news/refreshed-startup-program) and press release (https://newrelic.com/press-release/20260623-0).

Terms (https://newrelic.com/termsandconditions/startups-terms-and-conditions): there is no initial fee. Applying is not admission, and New Relic accepts applications and sets benefits at its sole discretion.

When the term or eligibility ends, New Relic may adjust the subscription. Either side can end participation at any time, and New Relic may change or end the program. Use beyond the program limits or after benefits expire is billed at standard fees.

offers.name: Bolt Free plan
offers.value: Free forever, no card required: 300K tokens daily limit and 1M tokens per month, public and private projects, website hosting and unlimited databases
offers.summary: Bolt is an AI-powered website and app builder. Its Free plan costs $0 with no credit card and gives 300K tokens a day and 1M tokens a month, plus hosting and databases; sites carry Bolt branding.
offers.who_qualifies: Open signup; no eligibility restrictions stated
offers.how_to_claim: Start for free at bolt.new. No credit card is required.
offers.caveats: Sites carry Bolt branding. File uploads are limited to 10MB and web requests to 333k. Free plan tokens do not roll over. Daily and monthly token limits apply.

offers.name: Scaleway Startup Program
offers.value: Founders: €1,000 in cloud credits over 12 months. Early Stage: €9,000 over 6 months. Growth Stage: up to €36,000 over 12 months, as 12 monthly vouchers.
offers.summary: Scaleway is a European cloud provider. Its Startup Program gives eligible startups cloud credits in three tiers: €1,000 over 12 months (Founders), €9,000 over 6 months (Early Stage), or up to €36,000 over 12 months (Growth Stage).
offers.who_qualifies: Companies less than 5 years old, with fewer than 50 employees, that are not already Scaleway clients (or are moving up from Founders). Early Stage also requires a minimum cloud consumption of €500/month. The main FAQ says Growth starts at €1,500/month consumption, and that you cannot move from Early Stage to Growth Stage.
offers.how_to_claim: Apply on the official program pages, including https://www.scaleway.com/en/startup-program/ (there is one form for all applications), or email startup-program@scaleway.com. Founders, Early Stage, and Growth each have their own program page with the same form.
offers.caveats: The FAQ figures of €500/month (Early Stage) and €1,500/month (Growth) are written as consumption thresholds, not as the credit amounts. The credit amounts on the program cards are 1,500€ per month for 6 months (Early) and 3,000€ per month for 12 months (Growth). Official pages disagree on how quickly applications are reviewed: the main FAQ says weekly, the tier-page FAQs say monthly, and the Founders and Early Stage eligibility boxes say under 21 business days. Founders is not renewable and is self-serve only (no CSM). Early Stage has CSM access on demand. Growth has a dedicated CSM. If usage goes beyond the vouchers, you pay the difference. The program is free to enter. A main-page FAQ also mentions a separate Nvidia Program with conditions similar to Growth Stage.

offers.name: WorkOS AuthKit free tier
offers.value: AuthKit User Management is free for the first 1 million monthly active users. Additional users are $2,500 per month per 1 million users.
offers.summary: WorkOS is an authentication and identity platform for applications. AuthKit User Management is free for the first 1 million monthly active users, with additional users billed at $2,500 per month per 1 million users.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up. No credit card is required until you are ready to move to production.
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at https://workos.com/signup, or use Sign up or Get started on https://workos.com/pricing. No credit card is required until you are ready to move to production.
offers.caveats: The pricing page also says WorkOS is free to get started, and you do not need to add a credit card until you are ready to move to production. All WorkOS products are available in staging at no cost. SSO and Directory Sync are billed separately per connection, not as part of the AuthKit user-management free allowance. A custom domain for AuthKit, Admin Portal, and the email sender address is $99 per month. Radar has a separate free allowance of the first 1,000 checks, which is not part of this AuthKit offer.

offers.name: OVHcloud Startup Program
offers.value: Start level: €10,000 in free cloud credits and 6 hours with an engineer, for 12 months. Scale level: up to €100,000 in free cloud credits and up to 20 hours with an engineer, for 12 months.
offers.summary: OVHcloud is a European cloud provider. Its Startup Program gives selected startups and scaleups free cloud credits and 1-on-1 engineer time for 12 months: €10,000 and 6 hours at Start level, or up to €100,000 and up to 20 hours at Scale level.
offers.who_qualifies: Start is for selected pre-seed and seed startups with an innovative technical project, growth potential, and at least a POC or MVP that can be used on OVHcloud. Scale is for selected series-A (and later) funded startups and scaleups; the voucher amount is based on assessed 12-month infrastructure spend. Not for NGOs or associations, prior program participants, or excluded activities such as cryptocurrency mining.
offers.how_to_claim: Choose the country site that matches your business address, then apply at https://startup.ovhcloud.com/en/login/ (the Apply button on the program pages). You can create an OVHcloud account in the form if you do not have one. You get a decision within 7 days. If accepted, you sign a contract and vouchers are issued within 48 hours.
offers.caveats: Vouchers can be used only on Public Cloud (for GPU instances, only V100, V100S and RTX5000 are eligible) and Hosted Private Cloud. Bare Metal Cloud and Web Cloud products are generally not covered. Participation starts when the contract is signed after acceptance. Vouchers are issued within 48 hours of that, must be used within the 12-month limit or they are lost, and unused vouchers are invalid afterward. You are not asked to repay used or unused vouchers, and OVHcloud does not take equity. You are charged only for products and solutions not covered by the vouchers. An event code on the application form is not mandatory and has no special advantages, except for startups in a support structure managed by a Premium partner, who should get the code from that partner. The Healthcare Accelerator listed on the program homepage is a separate program, with entries closing on 26 July 2026. There is also a separate Enablers track for partners.

offers.name: Clerk Hobby plan
offers.value: Hobby plan at $0: 50,000 monthly retained users and 100 monthly retained organizations included per app, no credit card required
offers.summary: Clerk is a developer-first user authentication and management service. Its Hobby plan is free, with no credit card required, and includes 50,000 monthly retained users and 100 monthly retained organizations per app.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up. No credit card is required.
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at https://dashboard.clerk.com/sign-up, or use Start building for free on https://clerk.com/pricing. No credit card is required.
offers.caveats: Limits are per app. A monthly retained user is a user who visits in a given month at least one day after signing up. A monthly retained organization is an organization with at least 2 members, where at least one member is a monthly retained user that month. Without the paid B2B Authentication add-on, organizations are limited to 20 members. If you exceed 50,000 MRUs you must upgrade to Pro; if you exceed 100 MROs you must upgrade to the B2B Authentication add-on. There is a one-month grace period so the app can keep running. Hobby does not include some Pro features, including MFA, SMS codes, passkeys, and removal of Clerk branding. Session lifetime is fixed at 7 days, and application logs are kept for 1 day. The clerk.com/startups page states the same free 50,000 MRU and 100 MRO amounts. The Pro discount for startups (up to 1 year after launch, up to $5 million in venture funding) is a separate discount-only program, not this offer.

offers.name: Upstash Redis Free plan
offers.value: Free plan at $0/month: 250 MB data, 10 GB bandwidth, 500K commands per month, 1 database
offers.summary: Upstash is a serverless Redis and data platform with a REST API. Its Redis Free plan is $0/month and includes 1 database with 250 MB of data, 10 GB of monthly bandwidth, and 500K commands per month.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up. A free account can have 1 database.
offers.how_to_claim: Start at https://console.upstash.com from the Redis pricing page. There is also a no-signup path: POST https://upstash.com/start-redis for a database that is deleted after 3 days unless you claim it into an account.
offers.caveats: The Free plan card, FAQ, plan overview, and https://upstash.com/pricing/redis.md say 250 MB max data. The interactive compare table on the pricing page also shows 256 MB in the Free column; the 250 MB figure is used here. There is a separate no-signup path: POST https://upstash.com/start-redis returns a free Redis database with no signup, credit card, or API key. It is deleted after 3 days unless claimed into an account, and once claimed it follows the pricing on this page. Upgrading from the free tier to pay-as-you-go happens when you enter a credit card. Paid plans do not include a free first 250 MB or 500K commands. Upstash can also provide separate free trials for testing and PoC if you email support@upstash.com.

offers.name: Turso Free plan
offers.value: Free plan, $0/month: 100 databases, 5GB storage, 500 million rows read, 10 million rows written, and 3GB monthly syncs
offers.summary: Turso is a SQLite-compatible database platform. Its Free plan is $0/month, with no credit card required, and includes 100 databases, 5GB storage, 500 million monthly rows read, 10 million monthly rows written, and 3GB monthly syncs.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up. No credit card is required.
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at https://app.turso.tech/signup, or use Sign up, Start for free, or Try Cloud free on https://turso.tech/pricing. No credit card is required.
offers.caveats: On the official pricing table, 5GB is storage and 3GB is the monthly sync allowance. If you exceed the limit on any single metric (storage, rows read, rows written, or syncs), your databases are blocked, even if other metrics are still under quota. To keep going, you need to upgrade to a paid plan. Restore Deleted DBs is not included on the Free plan, and a database deleted while you are on the Free plan is not guaranteed to be restorable after an upgrade. Point-in-time restore is limited to 1 day, and both restores and branches use a database slot and storage. A banner on the pricing page links to a 2 Oct 2026 post that Turso is being acquired by Supabase; that post says the Turso platform continues.

offers.name: Netlify Free plan
offers.value: Free plan, $0 forever, 300 credit limit per month
offers.summary: Netlify is a web hosting and deploy platform. Its Free plan is $0 forever, with a 300 credit limit per month, and includes deploys from AI, Git, or API, custom domains with SSL, functions and AI models, Netlify Database, blob storage, and a global CDN.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up. Limited to 1 free member, with unlimited Git Contributors on public repos. Additional team member seats cannot be added.
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at https://app.netlify.com/signup, or use Sign up or Start for free on https://www.netlify.com/pricing/.
offers.caveats: Credits are a monthly usage limit for production deploys, compute, form submissions, bandwidth, and web requests, not a one-time grant. The Free plan is always free, with hard monthly limits that cannot be exceeded or incur any costs. When a project reaches its monthly credit limit it is paused until the next billing cycle, and if one project exceeds its limits, all projects on the account are paused. The pricing page also mentions a separate Netlify Open Source plan for qualifying projects.

offers.name: Railway Free Trial
offers.value: $5 one-time credit, valid for 30 days
offers.summary: Railway is a hosting platform that bills per second for what an app uses. New users can start a free Trial with a one-time $5 credit that expires in 30 days, with no credit card required.
offers.who_qualifies: New Railway users who do not already have an account
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up for a free Trial by using Login on railway.com, or start at https://railway.com/new. No credit card is required.
offers.caveats: Credits apply to usage on the platform and expire in 30 days. The Free plan card says to start with a 30-day free trial with $5 credits, then $1 per month; the page does not call that $1 a usage credit. Hobby and Pro are the plans that list monthly usage credits ($5 and $20). Some features are trial-only and unavailable on the free plan. Trial resource limits are higher than after the trial (for example, 5 projects during the trial, then 1).

offers.name: Fly.io Startup Program
offers.value: Up to $15,000 in Fly.io credits, plus a shared Slack channel with the Fly.io team
offers.summary: Fly.io's startup program gives eligible Seed or Series A startups up to $15,000 in credits toward usage, plus a shared Slack channel with the Fly.io team. Credits expire one year after they are added.
offers.who_qualifies: Seed or Series A startups backed by a venture firm or an accelerator, that have not received Fly.io startup credits before. Bootstrapped or self-funded companies are not eligible.
offers.how_to_claim: Apply at https://fly.io/startups/. A human reviews the application and you hear back by email within a week. Credits are added to a Fly.io organization; you can apply without an account and sign up before the credits land.
offers.caveats: Credits apply to usage across Machines, Sprites, Managed Postgres, volumes and bandwidth. They do not cover support plans, compliance packages or Machine reservations. Credits expire one year after they are added. Bootstrapped or self-funded companies are not eligible. Fly.io may ask you to verify funding with an email intro to your investor or accelerator. The pricing page also lists a separate $1 free start with no credit card needed; that is not this program.

offers.name: Supabase Free plan
offers.value: Free Plan at $0/month: 500 MB database, 50,000 monthly active users, 5 GB egress, 1 GB file storage, 500,000 Edge Function invocations, 2 active projects; free projects pause after 1 week of inactivity
offers.summary: Supabase's Free Plan is $0/month and includes two active projects with a 500 MB database, 50,000 monthly active users, 5 GB egress, 1 GB file storage and 500,000 Edge Function invocations. Free projects pause after one week of inactivity.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone. No further eligibility limits are stated on the official pricing page.
offers.how_to_claim: Start a Free Plan project at https://supabase.com/dashboard/new?plan=free
offers.caveats: Free projects are paused after 1 week of inactivity. There is a limit of 2 active projects; you can have as many paused projects as you want. Card requirement is not stated on the official pricing page. The Free Plan also includes 5 GB cached egress and 50,000 Third-Party MAUs.

offers.name: AWS Free Plan
offers.value: Up to $200 in credits over 6 months ($100 on signup, up to $100 more for exploring services), with no charges on the Free plan unless you upgrade to a Paid plan or activate paid-only services
offers.summary: Amazon Web Services cloud platform. New customers get a Free plan with up to $200 in credits over 6 months and access to select services, plus 30+ always-free services within monthly limits.
offers.who_qualifies: New AWS customers only. Anyone with an existing or former AWS account is ineligible. Students, entrepreneurs and small businesses are welcome.
offers.how_to_claim: Create a new AWS account at https://aws.amazon.com/free/. New customers are automatically enrolled in the Free plan. Earn the extra credits by completing activities in the Explore AWS widget on the Console Home dashboard within 6 months.
offers.caveats: The Free plan is limited to select services and is not eligible for other promotional credits such as AWS Activate. The account is suspended when the plan ends (6 months or when credits run out); AWS keeps the data for 90 days, then permanently erases the account unless you upgrade to a Paid plan. A payment method is not required for most new customers, but AWS may request one for identity checks.

offers.name: v0 free plan $5 one-time credits
offers.value: $5 one-time credits for new users on the free plan
offers.summary: v0 by Vercel is an AI app builder that designs, codes and deploys full-stack web apps from a prompt. New users on the Free plan get $5 in one-time credits that do not renew. Existing Free users keep their monthly credits.
offers.who_qualifies: New users on the v0 Free plan. Existing Free users keep their monthly credits. No other eligibility limits are stated on the official pricing page.
offers.how_to_claim: Start on the Free plan at https://v0.app/pricing.
offers.caveats: The $5 is a one-time Free credit allowance that does not renew. Existing Free users keep their monthly credits. The page says to check billing settings for allowance and expiration dates, but does not publish those dates. The Free plan also has a 7 message/day limit.

offers.name: Crusoe Managed Inference credits for NVIDIA Inception members
offers.value: $10,000 in Crusoe Managed Inference credits plus one month of technical support
offers.summary: Selected NVIDIA Inception startups can apply for $10,000 in Crusoe Managed Inference credits, plus one month of 1:1 technical support from Crusoe Solutions Engineers. Credits are for the Crusoe Managed Intelligence platform only, expire 3 months from the issue date, and a US credit card must be on file. Packages are limited and acceptance is not guaranteed.
offers.who_qualifies: Eligible NVIDIA Inception members. A US credit card must be on file in the Crusoe account. The model should be in or near production (active users or customers, or a launch within 60 days), with business-critical latency or throughput and meaningful inference volume, and the team should be ready to make an infrastructure decision and agree to be featured by Crusoe. Packages are limited and acceptance is not guaranteed.
offers.how_to_claim: Eligible NVIDIA Inception members apply on the Crusoe Intelligence Foundry form. Create a Crusoe account at https://console.crusoecloud.com/request, with a US credit card on file. Crusoe will be in touch within 3 business days.
offers.caveats: Credits can be used across the Crusoe Managed Intelligence platform only and cannot be used for BYOM. Credits expire 3 months from the issue date. Packages are limited and acceptance is not guaranteed. The Foundry page states $10k in credits and 1:1 work with the Crusoe team, but does not itself mention NVIDIA Inception membership, the 3-month credit validity, or the US credit card requirement; those terms come from NVIDIA's Inception benefits catalog at https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/programs/benefits/. An employee post said 20 awards of $10k and listed serverless inference, dedicated inference, and managed fine-tuning; the official pages do not state a fixed number of awards and describe the credits as usable for Managed Inference on the Managed Intelligence platform.

offers.name: Zoom AI Launchpad
offers.value: Up to $150,000 in complimentary Zoom AI Services credits, equity-free, in three tiers ($5,000, $50,000 or $150,000)
offers.summary: Zoom AI Services offers speech, translation, summarization, voice and decision APIs. AI Launchpad is a grant program giving eligible AI-native startups $5,000, $50,000 or $150,000 in credits, valid 12 months, with no equity taken.
offers.who_qualifies: Early- to growth-stage startups building AI-first products, with a prototype, production product or clear technical roadmap; worldwide except US-sanctioned countries; funding not required; limited spots, rolling review at Zoom's discretion.
offers.how_to_claim: Apply on the official AI Launchpad page. A Zoom account is required. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis; shortlisted founders get a 20-minute call. Zoom aims to decide within one month. Credits are provisioned within 48 hours of signed acceptance.
offers.caveats: Credits expire 12 months after issuance with no cash value. A valid payment method is required after acceptance; overage is billed. Limited spots; acceptance and tier are at Zoom's discretion. Marketing tier names (Seed, Growth, Scale) differ from the terms (Launch, Scale, Propel); amounts match. One grant per participant. Credits apply only to Zoom AI Services.

offers.name: KaneCLI Online Hackathon: 10,000 free credits
offers.value: 10,000 free Kane CLI credits on a new TestMu AI account (valid one month), plus $3,000 in cash prizes
offers.summary: TestMu AI's KaneCLI Online Hackathon (12 to 26 November 2026) asks you to build with any AI coding agent and verify with Kane CLI. Every new TestMu AI account gets 10,000 free credits, valid one month. Submissions close at 11:59 PM IST on 26 November. The event has $3,000 in cash prizes.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone 18 or older, anywhere in the world, solo or teams of up to four. Credits are for a new TestMu AI account. To be scored you must sign up on testmuai.com, use the same email, and run Kane CLI.
offers.how_to_claim: Register for the hackathon at https://www.kaneclihack.sh/ and claim 10,000 credits at https://www.testmuai.com/kane-cli/#creditOffer, using the same email on both.
offers.caveats: The official deadline is 11:59 PM IST on 26 November 2026 (extended from 19 November); expiry is recorded as 2026-11-27 so the date sort does not treat it as ended during that IST evening. Credits last one month from claim (product page: 30 days) and may outlast the hackathon. The product page says you can start free with 10,000 credits; the hackathon FAQ specifies every new TestMu AI account. Card requirement is not stated. A public GitHub repo, YouTube demo and at least two public posts are required to submit. Employees and participating partners cannot win.

offers.name: Mixedbread Starter plan with $5 free credits
offers.value: $5 in one-time credits on the free Starter plan, no card required
offers.summary: Mixedbread turns PDFs, decks, videos, code, Slack and Drive into searchable evidence for AI agents. The free Starter plan gives $5 in one-time credits with no card, 3 workspace users and 3 stores.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up. The pricing page lists no eligibility limits for Starter. No card required.
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up from the Get started button on https://www.mixedbread.com/pricing, which opens the Mixedbread platform (https://www.platform.mixedbread.com/platform?next=/settings/billing).
offers.caveats: When the $5 credits are used up, you must upgrade to Scale to keep going. Starter is limited to 3 workspace users, 3 stores, 100 queries/min and 6,000 upload requests/min. The same pricing page also lists a separate Mixedbread for Startups program of up to $250 in one-time credits for qualified paying startups; that is not this offer.

offers.name: ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview free on OpenRouter
offers.value: Free ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview endpoint (baidu/ernie-5.5-flash-preview:free): $0 input and output, 1,024,000 token context, rate limited
offers.summary: OpenRouter lists Baidu's ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview as a free endpoint (baidu/ernie-5.5-flash-preview:free) served by Baidu Qianfan, with a 1,024,000 token context, 280B total parameters and 14B active, released 10 November 2026. Prompt and completion tokens are $0.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone with an OpenRouter API key
offers.how_to_claim: Create an OpenRouter API key at openrouter.ai, then call model baidu/ernie-5.5-flash-preview:free.
offers.caveats: OpenRouter free-model rate limits apply: 20 requests per minute and 50 requests per day, or 1,000 requests per day after purchasing at least $10 in credits (https://openrouter.ai/docs/api-reference/limits). A negative credit balance can block free models. Free preview models can be removed without notice. Posts citing 30 November refer to a Baidu Qianfan paid promo, not this free route.

offers.name: Inkling 2 Small free on OpenRouter
offers.value: Free Inkling 2 Small: $0 tokens, 1M context, agentic use only
offers.summary: OpenRouter lists Thinking Machines Lab's Inkling 2 Small, an open-weight multimodal MoE reasoning model (17B active of 594B total), as a free endpoint served by Thinking Machines. Prompt and completion tokens are $0, with a 1,048,576 token context. The free route is limited to agentic harnesses and is rate limited. The model ID is thinkingmachines/inkling-2-small:free; it accepts text and image input and supports tool calling.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone with an OpenRouter API key. The free endpoint is only available for use with agentic harnesses, and users must agree to the TML Free Research API Terms of Service.
offers.how_to_claim: Create an OpenRouter API key at openrouter.ai, then call model thinkingmachines/inkling-2-small:free. Use is subject to the TML Free Research API Terms of Service.
offers.caveats: The official page says this free endpoint is only available for use with agentic harnesses. Do not upload confidential information or personal data. Prompts and outputs are logged and used to improve Thinking Machines Lab's models, products, and services, under the TML Free Research API Terms of Service and Privacy Notice. OpenRouter free-model rate limits apply: 20 requests per minute and 50 requests per day, or 1,000 requests per day after purchasing at least $10 in credits (https://openrouter.ai/docs/api-reference/limits). A negative credit balance can block free models. The page says the endpoint is not currently available through EU in-region routing. It does not support response_format, so JSON output is not enforced. A separate paid Inkling 2 Small endpoint also exists on OpenRouter.

offers.name: Stripe Queries API free through Jan 2027
offers.value: Queries API free for all Stripe users through January 31, 2027; usage-based per-credit pricing from February 1, 2027 with no monthly subscription; Reports API remains free
offers.summary: Stripe lets Claude, Cursor and other agents analyze Stripe revenue and subscription data via Stripe MCP or the Queries and Reports APIs. The Queries API is free for every Stripe account through January 31, 2027; the Reports API stays free.
offers.who_qualifies: All Stripe users (connect via Stripe MCP in a compatible agent, or call the Queries API / Reports API with a restricted key that has Data Queries / Reports read)
offers.how_to_claim: In Claude or Cursor, connect the Stripe MCP (prompt "Pull my Stripe data in" if new) or call the Queries API / Reports API from https://docs.stripe.com/data/api with a restricted API key granted Data > Queries > Read and/or Data > Reports > Read.
offers.caveats: Queries API free period ends January 31, 2027; usage-based pricing starts February 1, 2027. Reports API remains free. Data APIs are in public preview. Needs a Stripe account and a restricted key with the right Data permissions.

offers.name: Free plan: 1,000 emails per month
offers.value: 1,000 transactional emails per month, 1 domain, 48-hour email logs, no credit card
offers.summary: Notify is a transactional email API for apps and AI agents, with an official MCP server. The free plan includes 1,000 emails per month, one domain and 48-hour logs, with no credit card required.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up. No credit card required.
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at notify.cx, create an API key, and add notifycx-mcp to your MCP client.
offers.caveats: Sending pauses when the 1,000 monthly limit is hit. Webhooks need Pro.

offers.name: Personal free plan
offers.value: Personal plan at $0: $1 of usage each month, 20 Spaces, 20 custom domains, no card required
offers.summary: Spacefast is Automattic's hosting home for apps and sites your AI agent builds. The Personal plan is free with $1 of included usage each month, 20 Spaces and 20 custom domains, and no card required.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up. No card required.
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at spacefast.com and start on the Personal plan.
offers.caveats: Unclaimed Spaces expire after about 33 hours (max 30 days) until you sign up and claim them. Only $1 of usage included per month.

offers.name: Free cloud Linux desktop for AI agents
offers.value: The computer: one cloud Linux desktop per account. Cost: your own AI keeps using its own plan. box credits pay for the Free box's time (100 credits an hour), extra boxes (from 100 credits an hour), residential IP on paid plans (10,000 credits a GB) and box's own model calls; 1,000 credits = $1. Free: 5,000 credits once (about 50 box-hours, valid 90 days).
offers.summary: Simular builds computer-use agents. Box is a cloud Linux desktop your AI can drive over MCP. Free accounts get 5,000 credits once (about 50 box-hours, valid 90 days); box time costs 100 credits an hour.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who creates a Simular account. No funding, student or region limits stated.
offers.how_to_claim: Connect with npx @simular-ai/box connect or add the hosted MCP at mcp.box.simular.ai and sign in.
offers.expiry: The Free plan is ongoing. The 5,000 free credits are a one-time grant, valid 90 days.
offers.caveats: A box asleep for 14 days in a row is deleted, with its files and saves; any wake resets the count. 1,000 credits = $1. Extra boxes start at 100 credits an hour. Residential IP on paid plans is 10,000 credits a GB.

offers.name: AMD AI Developer Program
offers.value: $100 complimentary AMD Developer Cloud credit on Instinct MI300X GPUs
offers.summary: AMD's AI Developer Program gives approved developers a complimentary $100 in AMD Developer Cloud credits on Instinct MI300X GPUs.
offers.who_qualifies: Independent developers and open-source contributors who join the free AMD AI Developer Program and apply; AMD approves at its discretion
offers.how_to_claim: Join the AMD AI Developer Program, then request cloud credits under Member Perks with your use case and a public profile (GitHub or LinkedIn). Approval takes 2-3 business days.
offers.caveats: Credits expire 30 days after deposit. Approval is at AMD's discretion. Member perks offer introductory options: AMD Developer Cloud ($100, expires 30 days after activation), Fireworks AI ($50, redeem within 90 days of issuance), or instant Token Lab API access (10 complimentary points with 30 day validity; no credit request form). Official Token Lab terms and model examples are on https://developer.amd.com/cloud-credit/.

offers.name: Free tier with up to 30 free credits
offers.value: Up to 30 free credits (~50 GPU hours) plus 1 free CPU Studio
offers.summary: Lightning AI is a cloud platform for building and training AI models. The free tier gives 5 credits at signup and 25 more after adding a card, plus one free CPU Studio running 24/7 with a restart every 4 hours.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up. No funding, student or region limits stated.
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at lightning.ai for 5 free credits, then add a card for 25 more.
offers.caveats: You get 5 credits at signup and 25 more after adding a card. Unused free credits expire in 12 months. A phone number is required to prevent abuse. The free CPU Studio runs 24/7 but restarts every 4 hours.

offers.name: Pipedream hosted MCP servers, free for personal use
offers.value: Hosted MCP servers for 3,000+ apps and 10,000+ prebuilt tools, free for your own use; free development mode for building into your own app
offers.summary: Pipedream is an integration platform for connecting APIs and building workflows. Its docs say anyone can use its hosted MCP servers, covering 3,000+ apps with managed OAuth, for their own use for free, and developers can start free in development mode.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone, for personal use; developers building for their users start free in development mode
offers.how_to_claim: Use the hosted MCP servers at mcp.pipedream.com for your own use, or add Pipedream MCP to your app or agent in development mode.
offers.caveats: Free only for your own use; making tool calls on behalf of your app's users in production needs a paid plan. Usage limits for free personal use are not stated on the docs page.

offers.name: IteraCompute free Qwen3.8-27B API
offers.value: Up to 30M free tokens a month via the Auto model ID (routes across open models including Qwen3.8-27B and DeepSeek V4.1), 128K context, no card
offers.summary: IteraCompute runs an OpenAI-compatible inference API on its own GPUs. Its free Auto route gives up to 30M tokens a month at $0 with no card, routing across open models including Qwen3.8-27B and DeepSeek V4.1. The free promotion ends at 00:00 Pacific Time on November 24, 2026.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who registers and verifies an email or signs in with Google
offers.how_to_claim: Register and verify your email, or sign in with Google. Open API Keys, create a key that allows Auto, then call the OpenAI-compatible API using the Auto model ID.
offers.caveats: Free capacity is shared and may queue; no SLA; output capped at 8,192 tokens; no RPM, TPM or daily token cap stated. Auto does not pin a particular model. Registration and email verification required.

offers.name: Velork Hobby plan
offers.value: 2,000 Velork AI credits to start on the free Hobby plan (one-time grant, about $2 of model usage), plus 10 AI images, 1 hour of cloud computer and 30 GB-hours of deployed apps a month
offers.summary: Velork is an IDE for frontend teams that lets you design with AI on a canvas next to your code. The free Hobby plan gives new accounts 2,000 Velork AI credits to start (about $2 of model usage), as a one-time grant that does not renew.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who creates a Velork account. No funding, student or region limits stated on the pricing or plans pages.
offers.how_to_claim: Create an account from https://velork.com/pricing (Get started or Download) and start on the free Hobby plan.
offers.caveats: The 2,000 credits are a one-time grant and do not renew. After they run out you connect your own AI provider or upgrade. The public pricing page also lists 10 AI images a month, 1 hour of cloud computer and 30 GB-hours of deployed apps on Hobby. The plans doc lists different credit amounts for Pro and Team than the pricing page, so those paid-plan figures are not included here.

offers.name: Otter Basic free plan
offers.value: Free Basic plan: 300 transcription minutes a month, 30 minutes max per conversation, 3 lifetime file imports and access to your last 25 conversations
offers.summary: Otter.ai is an AI meeting notetaker that joins Zoom, Microsoft Teams and Google Meet to transcribe calls live and write summaries with action items. The free Basic plan includes 300 transcription minutes a month, a 30-minute cap per conversation, 3 lifetime file imports and access to your 25 most recent conversations.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who creates an Otter.ai account. No funding, student or region limits are stated for Basic on the pricing page.
offers.how_to_claim: Open https://otter.ai/pricing and click Get started to create a free Basic account.
offers.caveats: Each conversation is capped at 30 minutes on Basic. If you go longer, only the first 30 minutes of the transcript stay accessible unless you upgrade. File imports are limited to three for the life of the account, not each month. Only the 25 most recent conversations stay visible; older ones are archived, not deleted. Monthly transcription minutes are a shared pool across live meetings and imports and do not roll over. Deleted conversations still count toward the monthly limit. Otter AI Chat is limited to 20 queries per user a month (3 per conversation). Exports on Basic are mp3 and txt only. The pricing page does not say whether a card is required to start Basic.

offers.name: Anyscale $100 signup credits
offers.value: $100 in Anyscale Credits
offers.summary: Anyscale is the managed platform for running Ray workloads on CPUs and GPUs, including hosted clusters and bring-your-own-cloud. New accounts can get started with $100 in Anyscale Credits, as stated on the pricing page and homepage; the pricing page does not say whether a card is required or when the credits expire.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who creates an Anyscale account. The pricing page does not say whether a card is required.
offers.how_to_claim: Click 'Get started with $100 credit' on the Anyscale homepage or pricing page and sign up for an Anyscale account.
offers.caveats: The pricing page does not say whether a card is required or when the credits expire. Hosted usage beyond the credits is billed by monthly credit card invoice.

offers.name: Explee $30 free credits
offers.value: $30 in free credits for the Outreach Agent (about 750 emails at ~$0.04 each)
offers.summary: Explee is an AI outbound agent that finds B2B leads from your website, writes and sends cold email from pre-warmed domains, and books meetings. New users get $30 in free credits when they set up billing; after that it is pay as you go with no subscription.
offers.who_qualifies: New Explee accounts that add a payment method to set up billing
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at https://explee.com, set up billing (card required for verification), and use the Outreach Agent; credits cover about 750 emails.
offers.caveats: A payment method is required to unlock the $30 credits; a temporary ~$1 card hold may appear and is released. After credits run out, usage is charged at about $0.04 per email sent within a daily budget you set. Finding leads is free. Free and promotional credits have no cash value.

offers.name: OpenRouter LFM3-1.7B free
offers.value: Free API access to liquid/lfm-3-1.7b:free ($0 prompt and completion tokens) with a 262,144 token context window
offers.summary: OpenRouter lists Liquid AI's LFM3-1.7B as a free route (liquid/lfm-3-1.7b:free) with a 262K-token context for agents, tool calling and structured outputs. Official FAQ says prompt and completion tokens are not charged.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone with an OpenRouter API key
offers.how_to_claim: Create an OpenRouter API key at openrouter.ai, then call model liquid/lfm-3-1.7b:free via the OpenAI-compatible chat completions API.
offers.caveats: OpenRouter free model rate limits apply (20 rpm / 50 rpd, or 1,000 rpd after $10 credits). Prompts and outputs may be retained and used to train Liquid models. Not available through EU in-region routing. Free preview models can be removed without notice.

offers.name: ZenRows Free plan
offers.value: 5,000 credits per month, free, no credit card
offers.summary: Zenrows Free gives 5,000 API credits every month with no card required. Credits cover Fetch, Extract, Crawl, Batch, and Browser on one balance, refresh monthly with no rollover, and are spent only on successful requests.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who creates a Zenrows account. No funding, student, or region limits stated.
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at https://app.zenrows.com/register (Start free on the pricing page). No credit card required.
offers.caveats: No rollover and no top-ups on Free. Standalone Residential Proxies are not included. Limit of 5 concurrent requests.

offers.name: HaveTML Free plan
offers.value: Free plan: unlimited artifacts with permanent links, MCP connector and REST API, pin comments, version history, Canvas and projects; no credit card
offers.summary: HaveTML is a home for AI-made HTML, Markdown, YAML and JSON: agents publish over MCP or REST to permanent sandboxed share links with comments and versions. The Free plan gives unlimited artifacts plus MCP/API with no card.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up. No funding, student or region limits stated.
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at havetml.com (Start free). The Free plan needs no card.
offers.caveats: The earlier first-500 Pro founder grant is no longer shown on the pricing page. Pro is $6/mo or $60/yr for password-protected links, link expiry and invited viewers/editors. Team is $20/mo for up to 10 editors.

offers.name: Nous Portal LongCat-2.5 free week
offers.value: Free access to LongCat-2.5 on Nous Portal (listed as LongCat-2.5:Free)
offers.summary: Nous Research is hosting Meituan's LongCat-2.5 multimodal model free on Nous Portal (LongCat-2.5:Free). The official X post said one week; the portal page lists it FREE with no end date.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone with a Nous Portal account (Free plan covers :free models)
offers.how_to_claim: Create or sign in to a Nous Portal account at portal.nousresearch.com, then select LongCat-2.5:Free from the model catalog.
offers.caveats: Official X post said free for one week from 2026-11-06; portal catalog has no published end date. Free-plan rate limits apply; Tool Gateway and paid models are separate.
offers.why_it_matters: Gives builders a free week to try Meituan's LongCat-2.5 multimodal model through Nous Portal.

offers.name: Fulcra Free plan
offers.value: Free plan with millions of agent-to-agent messages and 5 GB storage ($0, no credit card)
offers.summary: Fulcra's Free plan gives agent-to-agent messaging and shared context storage at $0, with millions of messages and 5 GB included. Confirmed on the official pricing page alongside Pro at $14.99/month.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone; account is created the first time you connect
offers.how_to_claim: Start at https://fulcra.ai/product/start-for-free: prompt your agent with the Fulcra get-started docs, add the MCP URL https://mcp.fulcradynamics.com/mcp, or run the CLI with uvx fulcra-api. No credit card required.
offers.caveats: Free is capped at 5 GB / millions of messages; Pro is needed for unlimited messages and storage. Insights on Free cover the last 7 days.
offers.why_it_matters: Gives founders a no-cost way to let Claude, ChatGPT and other agents share context and message each other via MCP/CLI.

offers.name: Maximo $5 free API credits
offers.value: $5 free API credits for new Maximo AI Platform accounts
offers.summary: Maximo AI gives every new Platform account $5 in free API credits (email verification required). After that, pay per token on the OpenAI-compatible API for Atlas and other Maximo models.
offers.who_qualifies: New Maximo AI Platform accounts; email verification required
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at https://maximoai.co/platform, verify your email, then create an API key in the console.
offers.caveats: Platform page calls the $5 credit a Limited Time Offer but states no end date. A separate 50% off through November 13 appeared in the source post; that percent discount is not part of this listing.

offers.name: Orkas 500 free credits
offers.value: 500 bonus lifetime credits for Orkas-managed models on free download ($0/month)
offers.summary: Orkas is a free, open-source (MIT), local-first multi-agent desktop app for Mac and Windows. New users get 500 bonus lifetime credits for managed Orkas models by signing in to the desktop app, so you can start without an API key.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who downloads the free Mac or Windows app and signs in to the desktop app
offers.how_to_claim: Download Orkas for macOS or Windows from https://orkas.ai/download/, install it, then sign in inside the desktop app. Web login does not grant the 500 credits.
offers.caveats: Credits cover Orkas-managed models only. Bring-your-own provider usage is billed by that provider. Web login does not grant the welcome credits.

offers.name: Stability AI 25 free API credits
offers.value: 25 free credits ($0.25 at $0.01/credit), one-time
offers.summary: Stability AI runs Stable Image, Stable Audio and 3D APIs. New platform accounts created with Google social login get 25 free credits to start (1 credit = $0.01).
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who creates a Stability AI Platform account with Google social login
offers.how_to_claim: Create a Stability AI Platform account with Google social login (Getting started docs say that grants the 25 free credits), then create an API key and check your balance on the billing page. See https://docs.stability.ai/getting-started and https://docs.stability.ai/pricing.
offers.caveats: Getting started docs tie the 25 free credits to Google social login; username/password signup is available but is not the path they describe for the free grant. Credits are one-time with no monthly refill. After they are spent, buy more at $1 per 100 credits on the billing page.

offers.name: AutomateSocials 50 free credits
offers.value: 50 free credits on signup (never expire)
offers.summary: AutomateSocials is an MCP-ready AI social media agent that writes, plans and publishes to Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, TikTok and YouTube. New accounts get 50 free credits that never expire; writing, scheduling and publishing are free, and credits pay for AI pictures, video, feed reading and X per-post fees.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up (18+)
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up with email and password at https://automatesocials.net/auth; 50 credits are added on signup
offers.caveats: Credits pay for pictures, video, feed reads and X fees; writing and publishing stay free. Must be 18+. Card needed only to buy more credit packs.

offers.name: Oumi Free Plan
offers.value: Up to $50 in credits for 3 months ($50 corporate email / $25 personal email)
offers.summary: Oumi Free plan is $0 with up to $50 in credits for 3 months ($50 with a corporate email, $25 personal) to explore and build a first custom model via FAiE agent automation, data synthesis, evaluation, and SFT/LoRA training.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up; corporate email gets $50, personal $25
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at https://platform.oumi.ai/signup (Start for Free on the pricing page).
offers.caveats: Credits expire after 3 months. Usage beyond the credit balance is billed. Billing docs say some actions may need a payment method even on Free.

offers.name: Notemaker Free plan
offers.value: Free plan: 1 hour of recording a month, 5 AI questions, AI summary/action items, last 30 days search; ₹0 forever
offers.summary: Notemaker is an AI meeting follow-up tool (Hindi, Hinglish, English). Its Free plan is ₹0 forever with 1 hour of recording a month and 5 AI questions; Pro and Team Pro are paid.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up free at notemaker.autobot360.com

offers.name: Nscale $5 free credit
offers.value: $5 free credit for every new Serverless Inference account
offers.summary: Nscale is a vertically integrated AI infrastructure company with an OpenAI-compatible Serverless Inference API. Official pages say every new account can claim $5 free credit, then create a service token and call the API.
offers.who_qualifies: Every new Nscale account; Google SSO signup only
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at the Nscale Console with Google, claim the $5 free credit, create a service token under Settings, then call https://inference.api.nscale.com/v1 with an OpenAI-compatible client.
offers.caveats: No published expiry for the $5 once claimed. After the credit runs out, add a card to buy more. Docs quickstart also mentions promotional free credits for early users.

offers.name: Slate Studio free credits
offers.value: 30 free credits on signup (Free plan); images and budget video models; 3 generations a day; no card
offers.summary: Slate Studio is an AI video studio that runs top video and image models (Kling, Seedance, Wan, FLUX, ElevenLabs and others) in one place with prices shown before you generate. New accounts get 30 free credits with no card required on the Free plan.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who creates a new Slate Studio account; no funding or region gate stated
offers.how_to_claim: Open https://slatestudio.us/ and choose Start free. Sign in with email; no card needed.
offers.caveats: Free plan is limited to images and budget video models and 3 generations a day. Free credits expire after 30 days. Paid plans start at $12/mo for 500 credits.

offers.name: Reducto Free Credits
offers.value: $150 in free usage on Standard
offers.summary: Reducto Standard includes $150 in free usage (15,000 credits) for new pay-as-you-go accounts, then list rates apply. Early-stage teams can also apply to the Startup Program for extra free credits and discounted Growth pricing.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone can claim $150 free Standard usage on signup. Startup Program extras need under $15M funding, under $3M annual revenue, and under 50 employees.
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at https://studio.reducto.ai for Standard - $150 / 15,000 credits apply on the free usage allotment. For Startup Program credits and Growth discounts, apply at https://reducto.ai/startups then create a Studio account with the same email (reply in 1-2 business days).
