offers.caveats: Free $150 is Standard-only; after that list rates apply. Startup Program credit size is not published and needs an application. Card requirement is not stated on the pricing page.

offers.name: PyAI for Startups
offers.value: Up to $100,000 in non-cash PyAI voice AI product credits (Starter $5,000 / Launch $20,000 / Growth $50,000 / Scale $100,000) plus managed phone minutes; $10M program for 200+ startups
offers.summary: PyAI for Startups is a $10M program giving 200+ startups non-cash voice AI product credits from $5,000 (Starter) to $100,000 (Scale), plus managed phone minutes. Credits last 12 months from activation and unlock in usage-gated tranches. No equity and no card required to apply.
offers.who_qualifies: Under $10M raised, incorporated under 7 years; working website; product live or launching within 6 months; bootstrapped, schools and NGOs welcome; not a current annual or enterprise PyAI customer
offers.how_to_claim: Apply at https://pyai.com/startups (no account needed). Review within five business days; activate with the application email within 90 days of approval.
offers.caveats: PyAI selects the tier. Credits unlock after 80% of prior AI credit is used. Phone numbers, SMS, taxes and enterprise add-ons need paid credit. Activate within 90 days. One award per company.

offers.name: THX-02 Free API Tier
offers.value: Free keyless API access to THX-01 and THX-02; THX-02 limited to 60 decisions per minute per IP
offers.summary: HAL-X hosts THX-02, an open-weight decision model for choice, yes/no and score questions with calibrated probabilities. Its free tier serves THX-01 and THX-02 without an API key, limited per client IP (60 decisions per minute for THX-02).
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone - no signup or API key required for the free per-IP tier
offers.how_to_claim: POST to https://api.hal-x.ai/v1/decide (or /v1/systemone) without an Authorization header; set model to thx-02 for THX-02. Docs: https://api.hal-x.ai/docs/thx-02. Optional: pip install thx02.
offers.caveats: Free tier is per client IP; THX-02 is 60 decisions per minute (each question counts). Over limit returns 429. Higher limits need a HAL-X API key.

offers.name: AlloyDB Express Free Tier
offers.value: 50 compute units and 2 GB of storage free each month per billing account for the first 12 months
offers.summary: Google Cloud's AlloyDB Express is a scale-to-zero PostgreSQL configuration for prototyping and AI coding agents. Its free tier gives 50 compute units and 2 GB of storage per billing account each month for the first 12 months.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone with a Google Cloud billing account; free tier is per billing account on AlloyDB Express
offers.how_to_claim: In a Google Cloud project, create an AlloyDB Express cluster and primary instance from the console, gcloud beta alloydb, REST or the AlloyDB remote MCP server (see https://docs.cloud.google.com/alloydb/docs/create-manage-express-clusters).
offers.caveats: Free tier is per billing account for the first 12 months; overage and storage above 2 GB are billed. Pricing page says billing starts December 2026. Paused compute is free; used storage still bills. CUDs are not available on Express.

offers.name: Medux Free plan
offers.value: 3,000 free trial credits per month
offers.summary: Medux is an AI media API and MCP server that lets apps and agents generate and edit images, video and voice. The Free plan includes 3,000 trial credits per month, shared across the browser Workshop, API and MCP.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone on the Free plan; new users start with the trial credits
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at medux.io and use the Free plan credits in Workshop, API or MCP
offers.caveats: Credit-based, not unlimited; Free plan limits vary by tool. Site markets uncensored and NSFW image and video models and face swap.

offers.name: tl;dv Free plan
offers.value: Free plan: unlimited meeting recordings and transcription, plus 10 meetings with AI notes and 10 Ask AI queries (up to 5 single-meeting and 5 multi-meeting)
offers.summary: tl;dv is an AI meeting recorder and note-taker for Zoom, Google Meet and Teams. Its Free plan ($0, no credit card) gives unlimited recordings, transcription in 100+ languages and storage, with AI notes capped at 10 meetings and Ask AI at 10 queries.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up for tl;dv Free; no credit card required
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up for free at https://tldv.io/app/pricing/ - no credit card required.
offers.caveats: AI notes are limited to 10 meetings. Ask AI is up to 5 single-meeting queries and 5 multi-meeting queries; the plan card also says 10x Ask AI queries. Reset period is not stated. Data retention is up to 3 months, with a 3 hour recording limit, 40 web recordings per week, 2 simultaneous meetings, and up to 5 uploads and 5 recording trims.

offers.name: Brave Search API free monthly credits
offers.value: $5 in free credits every month on the Search plan (about 1,000 requests at $5 per 1,000); the Answers, Spellcheck and Autosuggest plans each also include $5 in free credits a month
offers.summary: Brave runs an independent web search index and sells it as a search API for AI agents and apps, with LLM-ready context. Every account gets $5 in free credits each month, applied automatically; a card is required to prevent abuse.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who activates a Brave Search API plan with a credit card on file
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up on the Brave Search API dashboard, activate a plan with a credit card and set the prepay amount to $0; the $5 monthly credit is applied automatically. Then create an API key.
offers.caveats: Card required at signup (refunded $0 or $1 hold). No standalone free plan; set prepay to $0 to use only the free $5. Free credits reset monthly and do not roll over. The marketing page at brave.com/search/api no longer shows the $5 free monthly line; the official docs FAQ still confirms it. Brave's February 2026 launch blog says you must attribute the Brave Search API on your project's site to use the free credit. Up to $20 a month in total across the four plans.

offers.name: Vultr $300 free credit for new accounts
offers.value: $300 free credit for new customers with code FLY300VULTR, on select products only
offers.summary: Vultr is a cloud provider offering compute, GPU and storage infrastructure. New customers can use code FLY300VULTR to get $300 in free credit on select products, per Vultr's own promo code page; restrictions and terms apply.
offers.who_qualifies: New Vultr customers only
offers.how_to_claim: Open a new Vultr account and apply promo code FLY300VULTR, listed on Vultr's promo code page.
offers.caveats: Credit applies to select products only, cannot be combined with other offers, and the credit's validity period is not stated on the official page.

offers.name: Daytona $200 free compute
offers.value: $200 in free compute (one-time)
offers.summary: Daytona runs fast, isolated sandboxes for AI agents to execute code, billed per second. New accounts get $200 in free compute with no credit card required, and startups can apply separately for larger credits.
offers.who_qualifies: Any new account, no credit card required
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up for a free account at https://www.daytona.io/pricing - no card needed; the $200 credit is added to your wallet.
offers.caveats: Free credits can't be used for GPU sandboxes. One-time signup credit, then billed per second. Startups can apply separately for up to $50k in credits.

offers.name: Context.dev free tier
offers.value: 1,000 free API credits per month, plus a one-time 10K logo quota
offers.summary: Context.dev is a web data API for AI agents: scrape, crawl, search and structured extraction through one API. Its Free Tier gives 1,000 credits a month with no credit card, enough for about 1,000 standard page scrapes, plus a one-time 10K logo quota.
offers.who_qualifies: Any new account, no credit card required
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up for the Free Tier at https://www.context.dev/pricing - no card needed.
offers.caveats: Credits vary by endpoint (JSON extraction 5 per page, Brand 10, Answers 10 to 100). Free plan allows 2 concurrent requests and has no overage.

offers.name: animatiQ free credits
offers.value: Free signup credits, no card (amount not stated on the official site)
offers.summary: animatiQ is an AI motion design studio that turns a brief or product URL into launch, demo and explainer videos. New signups start with free credits and no card.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at animatiq.ai; free credits are added to start, no card needed.
offers.caveats: The official site does not state the credit amount (animatiQ's launch post on X says 500). Credits are spent on research, generation and rendering.

offers.name: SerpKite free credits
offers.value: Up to 2,500 free credits at signup plus 1,000 free credits every month
offers.summary: SerpKite is a Google SERP API for AI agents that returns live search, news, maps, shopping and AI assistant answers as JSON or Markdown, with an MCP server and SDKs. The free plan gives 2,500 credits at signup and 1,000 free credits every month with no card.
offers.who_qualifies: New signups with a non-disposable email, no credit card or subscription
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at serpkite.com, verify your email for 1,000 credits, then link GitHub or Google for 1,500 more.
offers.caveats: Signup and linking credits come from a monthly free budget; if it runs out, later signups that month get 250 each instead. Free keys are limited to 5 requests per second. Most endpoints cost 1 credit, AI assistant and research endpoints cost more.

offers.name: SCALE at GMI Cloud startup program
offers.value: Up to $40K+ in structured credits: $500 MaaS credits on acceptance, 1:1 MaaS credit matching up to $4,500, 20% off dedicated endpoints, a GPU voucher after the program, plus partner credits. Equity-free, Cohort 03 applications open (Spring 2027).
offers.summary: GMI Cloud is an AI-native inference and GPU cloud. Its equity-free SCALE program for AI-native startups gives up to $40K+ in structured credits, starting with $500 in model API credits on acceptance and 1:1 credit matching up to $4,500, and Cohort 03 applications are open now.
offers.who_qualifies: AI-native startups with technical founders, accepted by application into the cohort.
offers.how_to_claim: Apply to Cohort 3 from the official SCALE page at https://www.gmicloud.ai/en/company/scale (Apply to Cohort 3).
offers.caveats: Credits come in stages and the $4,500 match needs equal spend of your own. Cohort 3 credit terms are to be confirmed before kickoff, and partner credits are marked upcoming. No application deadline published.

offers.name: Mem0 Free plan
offers.value: Free plan: first 30 days 10,000 memory adds and 1,000 retrievals a month with model calls on Mem0; with your own LLM key 50,000 adds and 10,000 retrievals a month; unlimited end users
offers.summary: Mem0 is a memory layer for AI agents and LLM apps. Its Free plan gives unlimited end users, 10,000 adds and 1,000 retrievals a month for the first 30 days with model calls on Mem0, then 50,000 adds and 10,000 retrievals a month with your own LLM key.
offers.who_qualifies: Any developer building and testing with Mem0
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up from https://mem0.ai/pricing (Get started) or https://app.mem0.ai and start on the Free plan.
offers.caveats: No graph memory on Free. Usage past limits is billed with a monthly cap you set.

offers.name: Speechmatics $100 free credits
offers.value: $100 in free credits on sign-up, no card required
offers.summary: Speechmatics makes speech-to-text and text-to-speech APIs for pre-recorded and real-time audio. New self-serve accounts start free with $100 in credits and no card required, and sign-up bonus credits last 12 months.
offers.who_qualifies: New Speechmatics self-serve accounts
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up for a free account from the Speechmatics pricing page; the $100 in credits is added to the new account.
offers.caveats: Credits last 12 months. On the free tier API access pauses when credits run out, and the free tier is limited to 2 concurrent real-time sessions. The post's 800-hour figure uses a discounted rate; at the $0.24/hr base rate $100 is about 416 hours of pre-recorded transcription.

offers.name: Fellow free plan
offers.value: Free plan with 5 AI notes and 5 AI recordings per user (lifetime), $0
offers.summary: Fellow is an AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes and summarizes meetings on Zoom, Google Meet and Teams. Its free plan gives each user 5 AI notes and 5 AI recordings in total, with AI summaries, action items and Slack integration.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone; Free workspaces have up to 5 seats
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up for free at fellow.ai, no credit card required.
offers.caveats: AI notes, recordings and uploads are 5 per user lifetime, not monthly. Free plan capped at 5 seats.

offers.name: Mermail free plan
offers.value: Free plan: 1 inbox, 1,000 emails a month, 1 GB storage and 1,000 API credits per period
offers.summary: Mermail gives AI agents their own email inboxes through an API and MCP server, with an optional agent wallet for payments. The free plan includes 1 inbox, 1,000 emails a month, 1 GB storage, 10 API requests a minute and 1,000 API credits per period.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up for Mermail. The Free plan is owner only, with no team member invites.
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at https://console.mermail.app and pick the Free plan.
offers.caveats: [crypto] Mermail also runs an x402 marketplace of paid services and an optional Agent Wallet for agent payments. Wallet funding is separate from the free inbox. The Free plan is owner only, uses a Mermail-hosted address (custom domains start at $19 a month) and allows 10 API requests a minute.

offers.name: Devin for Startups
offers.value: $15,000 in Devin credits on approval, plus up to $50,000 in 1:1 matching grants on reloads
offers.summary: Devin, from Cognition, is an AI software engineer that writes PRs, fixes bugs and runs refactors and migrations. Devin for Startups loads $15K in free Devin credits on approval and dollar-matches reloads up to $50K in grants on the next $100K of usage.
offers.who_qualifies: Startups and early-stage teams that apply and are approved; the official page states no funding, size or region criteria.
offers.how_to_claim: Apply on https://devin.ai/startups. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and the $15K credits land in your account the day you're approved.
offers.caveats: The $50K matching grant only applies to money you reload and spend, so only the $15K is free up front.

offers.name: AI Sales Hackathon Stockholm
offers.value: 100 free Lovable credits for every participant
offers.summary: Capable, an AI-native CRM, is running a one-day in-person AI sales hackathon in Stockholm, sponsored by Sting and Lovable. Every participant gets 100 free Lovable credits to build AI sales workflows.
offers.who_qualifies: Sellers and founders from Stockholm startups who attend in person; free registration subject to host approval
offers.how_to_claim: Request to join on the Luma event page, wait for host approval, and attend the hackathon on 5 December 2026 at A house Ark, Ostermalmsgatan 26A, Stockholm
offers.caveats: In-person only in Stockholm, limited spots, host approval required. Credits are from sponsor Lovable; delivery details not stated.

offers.name: Helpnest for Startups
offers.value: 3 months free on the Startups plan (4,000 AI credits a month) or Growth plan (16,000 AI credits a month), or 6 months free on Growth via accelerator partners; 50 pilot spots, no card
offers.summary: Helpnest is an AI customer support agent trained on your website and docs. Its startup pilot gives eligible founders 3 to 6 months of a paid plan free, with up to 16,000 AI credits a month.
offers.who_qualifies: Startups that have raised under $5M in total or are bootstrapped, with a live product or launching within 3 months, not already paying for Helpnest
offers.how_to_claim: Apply with a work email on the Helpnest for Startups page, wait for manual approval (usually a few business days), then sign up with the same email; the plan is applied automatically.
offers.caveats: 50-company pilot with manual review. Accelerator Partner needs a referral. AI replies use 1, 5 or 20 credits each and credits don't roll over. After the free period it's $5 or $20 a month, or the account moves to Free.

offers.name: Kaiva Bridge Free plan
offers.value: Free plan: 10 MCP servers, 200,000 tool calls a month, 3 team members, no card, no expiry
offers.summary: Kaiva Bridge hosts managed MCP servers that connect your own APIs and databases to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other AI clients. Its free plan, now raised to 10 servers, includes 200,000 tool calls a month and 3 team members with no card and no expiry.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone - sign up with an email, no card
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up free at kaiv.ai/bridge and deploy an MCP server
offers.caveats: Free plan has 7-day audit retention and no custom domains, SSO or write approvals. At the monthly limit new calls get an upgrade prompt; no card is charged without upgrading.

offers.name: Click Managed Agents API Free plan
offers.value: Free plan: 2 concurrent sessions, 100 MB storage, 1 managed sandbox hour, 1 browser hour and 100 web searches a month
offers.summary: Click (Click AI Labs, YC Summer 2026) is a managed agents API: send a task over HTTP and it runs the agent with a built-in sandbox, browser and web search, streaming results back. The Free plan is $0 a month with 2 concurrent sessions, 1 sandbox hour, 1 browser hour and 100 web searches a month.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who creates a Click account. No funding, student or region limits stated.
offers.how_to_claim: Choose Start free on https://useclick.ai/pricing and create an account at https://useclick.ai/signup.
offers.caveats: Bring your own model keys; model usage is billed by your provider, not included.

offers.name: NotesXD Free Plan and Pro Trial
offers.value: Free plan forever (notes and tasks) plus a 14-day free Pro trial with no card required (Pro is $11.99/month)
offers.summary: NotesXD is a native Mac app for AI meeting notes, tasks and on-device transcription. Notes and tasks are free forever, and every new install gets a 14-day Pro trial with live transcription and AI chat, no card required.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone with a Mac on macOS 14 or later
offers.how_to_claim: Download NotesXD from notesxd.com; every new install starts a 14-day Pro trial automatically, then drops to the free plan.
offers.caveats: Mac only. AI features (transcription, AI chat, active listening) are Pro-only after the trial.

offers.name: Nephew Free plan
offers.value: Free plan: 2 profiles on your own cloud accounts, 1 run at a time
offers.summary: Nephew lets AI agents carry your logged-in browser profile, device identity and IP into any sandbox so agent runs don't hit login walls. Its Free plan costs $0 and includes 2 profiles on your own cloud accounts with 1 run at a time.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who installs the Nephew CLI and connects their own cloud accounts
offers.how_to_claim: Install the CLI with the script on nephew.ai, then run nephew init to connect your own cloud accounts. No sign-up needed for Free.
offers.caveats: Bring-your-own mode only: you need your own Modal, Steel, Browser Use or Browserbase accounts and pay them directly. 1 run at a time.

offers.name: AssemblyAI $50 free credits
offers.value: $50 in free credits for new accounts, no expiry, covering Pre-recorded STT, Real-time STT, Speech Understanding and Guardrails (not LLM Gateway)
offers.summary: AssemblyAI offers speech-to-text and speech understanding APIs. Every new account gets $50 in free credits that don't expire, usable on transcription, streaming, Speech Understanding and Guardrails.
offers.who_qualifies: Any new AssemblyAI account
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up for a free AssemblyAI account; the $50 in credits is added automatically, no card needed.
offers.caveats: Credits don't cover LLM Gateway. Add a card once the credits run out, or API access pauses at a $0 balance. Streaming is billed on how long the session stays open.

offers.name: Fireflies for Startups
offers.value: 6 months of Fireflies Business free with unlimited seats and 10,000 AI credits
offers.summary: Fireflies.ai is an AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes and summarizes calls. Its startup program gives eligible early-stage startups 6 months of the Business plan free with unlimited seats and 10,000 AI credits.
offers.who_qualifies: Startups incorporated within the last 5 years that have raised less than $5M in total funding
offers.how_to_claim: Fill out the short application at http://ffstartups.paperform.co/ linked from the Fireflies for Startups page; approval comes within 48 hours.

offers.name: Runway Builders Program
offers.value: Up to 500,000 free Runway API credits, Tier 5 API usage limits and Runway Characters API access
offers.summary: Runway makes generative video models and the Characters real-time conversational avatar API. The Runway Builders Program gives Seed to Series C startups up to 500k free API credits, Tier 5 rate limits, Runway Characters access and a private builder community.
offers.who_qualifies: Seed to Series C startups building with the Runway API, by application
offers.how_to_claim: Apply through the Apply Now form on the Runway Builders Program page. Questions go to runway-builders@runwayml.com.

offers.name: Linkup startup program
offers.value: Up to $5,000 in one-time search API credits (1,000,000+ calls), more on a case-by-case basis
offers.summary: Linkup is a real-time web search API for AI apps and agents. Its startup program gives a one-time credit of up to $5,000 to projects that have a Linkup account and say what they are building.
offers.how_to_claim: Create a Linkup account, then apply on linkup.so/startups with a few details on what you are building; Linkup replies within the week if it is a fit.

offers.name: Inception Mercury API free tokens
offers.value: 100 million free tokens with every new Inception API key
offers.summary: Inception builds Mercury, a family of fast diffusion-based LLMs served through an OpenAI-compatible API. Every new Inception API key now includes 100 million free tokens, up from 10 million, along with 10x higher free-tier rate limits.
offers.who_qualifies: Any developer who creates a new Inception API key
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at platform.inceptionlabs.ai, go to API Keys and create a new key; the 100 million free tokens come with it.
offers.caveats: One-time allowance per new API key. Free tier is rate limited; paid plans raise limits.

offers.name: Murf Startup Incubator Program
offers.value: $1,500 in free Murf API credits for 3 months
offers.summary: Murf AI offers AI voice generation and text-to-speech APIs. Its Startup Incubator Program gives approved early-stage startups $1,500 in free API credits for 3 months.
offers.who_qualifies: Startups under 10 years since incorporation, fewer than 100 employees, with a working website and a valid Murf API use case; resellers do not qualify
offers.how_to_claim: Apply with the form on murf.ai/startup-program; Murf's team reviews it and adds the credits on approval
offers.caveats: One-time offer, no reapplication. Usage beyond $1,500 is billed pay-as-you-go.

offers.name: SambaNova Cloud Free Tier
offers.value: Free Tier (no payment method linked): gpt-oss-120b and gemma-4-31B-it each have 20 RPM, 20 RPD and 200000 TPD.
offers.summary: SambaNova runs SambaCloud, a fast inference API. Accounts with no payment method linked get a Free Tier with 200,000 tokens a day per model on gpt-oss-120b and gemma-4-31B-it.
offers.who_qualifies: Any SambaCloud account with no payment method linked
offers.caveats: Capped at 20 requests per day per model. Linking a payment method switches the account to the paid Developer Tier. Preview models may be removed at short notice.

offers.name: Enhanced Radar API free credits
offers.value: $1,000 in free credits for new accounts
offers.summary: Enhanced Radar is an aviation data API with natural-language search over air traffic control transcripts and audio, flight and airport status, and an MCP server for AI agents. New accounts get $1,000 in free credits.
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at https://api.enhancedradar.com, or connect the MCP server https://api.enhancedradar.com/api/mcp and create an account during OAuth sign-in. The $1,000 credit applies to new accounts.
offers.caveats: Credits are used at per-request prices. Data covers North American airspace only. Whether a card is needed at sign-up is not stated.

offers.name: Sail for Startups
offers.value: Up to $10,000 in free credits for inference and Sailboxes
offers.summary: Sail Research runs an OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible inference API for open models plus Sailboxes, persistent sandboxes for long-running agents. Its startup program gives up to $10,000 in free credits shared between inference and Sailboxes, plus direct Slack support and swag.
offers.how_to_claim: Apply on the Sail for Startups page using your Sail account email and describe your company and how you'll use Sail. If approved, credits are added to your Sail account and you're notified by email.

offers.name: Agent 37 free starter credit
offers.value: $5 starter credit for new accounts
offers.summary: Agent 37 is a YC-backed cloud sandbox for hosting AI agents, billed per minute from a prepaid balance. New accounts get a $5 starter credit once a card is on file, and the site also lists up to $10,000 in credits for startups ($1,000 to start, then matched spend).
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at agent37.com and add a card to your account to receive the $5 starter credit.
offers.caveats: Card on file required for the $5 credit. Startup credits beyond $1,000 are matched to spend and need a call.

offers.name: Modal Starter plan free compute
offers.value: $30 per month in free compute credits
offers.summary: Modal is a serverless cloud for running AI inference, training, batch jobs and sandboxes on GPUs and CPUs. Its Starter plan has no monthly fee and includes $30 of compute each month, with up to 3 seats and 10 GPU concurrency.
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at modal.com and use the Starter plan (Get started on the pricing page)
offers.caveats: Per modal.com/pricing, usage above $30 is billed, and Shared Endpoints token usage is billed from the first request and is not covered by the included compute (since Sept 1, 2026). Source post is from a small tools directory account; official page used for terms.

offers.name: Fireworks free Muse Glimmer fine-tuning
offers.value: Free training of Muse Glimmer 30B with supervised fine-tuning (SFT), DPO, and RL through November 30, no credit card required
offers.summary: Fireworks AI is an inference and model training platform for open models. Muse Glimmer 30B is free to train with SFT, DPO, and RL through November 30, kicking off its Free Weights Club.
offers.who_qualifies: Any Fireworks AI user, no credit card required
offers.how_to_claim: Start an SFT job on Muse Glimmer 30B in the Fireworks app or API with Managed Training, or write your own loop with the Serverless Training API, before the end of November 30.
offers.caveats: Only training is free - inference, including evaluation calls, is billed separately. Muse Glimmer 30B is deprecated from Fireworks public serverless inference, so serving a tuned model may need a dedicated deployment.

offers.name: Oracle Cloud Free Tier
offers.value: US$300 cloud credit for 30 days plus Always Free services
offers.summary: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is Oracle's cloud platform for compute, databases and storage. New Free Tier accounts get a US$300 credit for 30 days (select countries) plus Always Free services such as Arm-based Ampere A1 compute, with a card needed for identity checks.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone opening a new Oracle Cloud account (one per person). The US$300 credit is offered in select countries only.
offers.caveats: Card required for identity checks (no prepaid, virtual or PIN debit cards). The US$300 credit lasts up to 30 days. Idle accounts may be suspended after 30 days. Always Free capacity is limited.

offers.name: Tabrein free credits
offers.value: 200 free credits to start, no card, credits never expire
offers.summary: Tabrein is an AI assistant for Google Chrome that opens pages, clicks, types and fills forms in its own tab, asking before irreversible actions. New users get 200 free credits with no card, and credits never expire.
offers.how_to_claim: Create an account on tabrein.com and add the extension to Chrome; new accounts get 200 credits with no card.
offers.caveats: 200 credits is about 40 Fast steps or 13 Smart steps. Chrome on a computer only. The site still marks the Chrome listing as coming soon.

offers.name: Freebuff free coding agent
offers.value: Free coding agent with frontier coding models, funded by ads - no card and no credits to track
offers.summary: Freebuff is a coding agent with a CLI, desktop and mobile apps. Its site says it is 100% free forever, funded by ads, with frontier coding models and no card or credits needed.
offers.how_to_claim: Download the desktop or mobile app from freebuff.com, run npm install -g freebuff for the CLI, or open it in the browser.
offers.caveats: Ad-supported. Usage limits are not stated on the official page. Mobile is Android only for now.

offers.name: SiteSelf free credits
offers.value: 2,500 free credits, no credit card
offers.summary: SiteSelf is an AI agent for WordPress. Every account starts with 2,500 free credits and no card; the paid plan is $49 a month per account for work across all sites.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone with a WordPress site - every new account
offers.how_to_claim: Create an account on siteself.com and connect your WordPress site; 2,500 free credits are added automatically, and no credit card is needed.
offers.caveats: Free credits are a starting balance, not a monthly allotment. After they run out the plan is $49/mo. Extra credit packs are $25 for 1,500 credits.

offers.name: NOAN for Startups
offers.value: 12 months of the NOAN Team plan free (up to 15 seats, unlimited facts and API keys)
offers.summary: NOAN is fact infrastructure for agentic companies, giving models, agents and apps one verified source of company facts over an API and MCP. Its startup grant gives pre-seed to Series B B2B agentic startups twelve months of the Team plan free, with no equity, fees or card.
offers.how_to_claim: Open the Verity chat on https://www.getnoan.com/startups and answer about nine questions (about five minutes, no deck). A person reviews the application and replies by email within a week.
offers.caveats: For B2B agentic startups under 50 people, founded within five years, pre-seed to Series B. Grantees add a Built on NOAN badge, give logo rights, write one case study and deploy agents on the API within 90 days. One grant per company; existing paying customers and agencies are not eligible.

offers.name: Deepgram $200 free credit
offers.value: $200 free credit on sign-up (about 43,000 minutes of Nova-3 transcription), no card, no expiry
offers.summary: Deepgram makes speech-to-text, text-to-speech and voice agent APIs. New pay-as-you-go accounts start with a free $200 credit that does not expire and needs no credit card, enough for roughly 43,000 minutes of Nova-3 transcription.
offers.caveats: Source post links to a third-party credits directory (tools.openkrill.app); the official terms are on deepgram.com/pricing. Separate from the live Deepgram Startup Program.

offers.name: Tazo free audio minutes on sign-up
offers.value: 15 free minutes of audio for new accounts
offers.summary: Tazo Labs makes Tazo, an audio decision model for live voice agents that takes raw call audio and returns calibrated probabilities for each option. Every new account starts with 15 free minutes of audio, shared by the playground and all API keys.
offers.caveats: The founder post says only "free credits for every new sign-up"; the amount (15 free minutes) comes from the official docs. Creating extra keys does not add free time.

offers.name: StepAudio 3 models free until November 23
offers.value: StepAudio 3 series speech models free on the StepFun API for a limited time
offers.summary: StepFun is a Chinese AI lab with an API platform for its Step language and StepAudio speech models. Its StepAudio 3 series (speech recognition, text-to-speech, realtime voice, voice and music generation) is free on the API until 11:59:59 AM on November 23, 2026 (UTC+8), and billed at list prices from 12:00:00 PM on November 23, 2026 (UTC+8).
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone with a StepFun API account
offers.caveats: The free window ends 11:59:59 AM on November 23, 2026 UTC+8. New list prices take effect at 12:00:00 PM on November 23, 2026 UTC+8.

offers.name: fal for Startups
offers.value: YC and a16z: $50,000 serverless or $20,000 model API credits; Entrepreneur's First: $10,000; Startup Program: $1,000 growing to $5,000
offers.summary: fal is a generative media platform with APIs for 1,000+ image, video and audio models and serverless GPUs. fal for Startups gives YC and a16z companies $50,000 in serverless or $20,000 in model API credits, Entrepreneur's First teams $10,000, and a Startup Program for generative-media startups starting at $1,000 and growing to $5,000 with usage.
offers.caveats: Startup Program tier is aimed at generative-media startups in Europe and Asia with real traction, per the official page.

offers.name: You.com Web Search API free credits
offers.value: You get $10 in API credit when you sign up and $90 more when you verify your account, no credit card required. The pricing table still shows $10 free credit = 2,000 searches. The MCP free tier is 100 Web Search API queries/day via MCP, with no API key, no account, and no credit card.
offers.summary: You.com runs search and research APIs built for AI apps and agents. New API accounts get $100 in free credits with no card ($10 at signup, $90 after verifying), about 20,000 web searches, valid for 60 days, and its MCP server gives up to 100 free Web Search queries a day with no key.
offers.who_qualifies: New You.com API accounts; the MCP free tier needs no account. Eligible early-stage startups can ask sales for extended credits.
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up for a You.com API account at you.com/platform and verify the account to unlock the extra $90. For the no-key tier, point an MCP client at api.you.com/mcp?profile=free.
offers.expiry: Free signup credits are valid for 60 days. The free-credit program itself is still offered on an ongoing basis.
offers.caveats: Official pricing FAQ now confirms $10 at signup plus $90 after you verify your account, and that free signup credits are valid for 60 days. The pricing table still shows $10 free credit = 2,000 searches. The MCP free tier remains 100 Web Search queries a day with no key or account.

offers.name: OpenWeb Ninja Real-Time AliExpress Data API free plan
offers.value: Free plan: 100 requests a month, rate limit 1,000 requests an hour, no credit card
offers.summary: OpenWeb Ninja builds real-time public web data APIs. Its new Real-Time AliExpress Data API (product search, details, reviews, shipping, stores) has a free plan with 100 requests a month and no credit card.
offers.caveats: The post's WELCOME15 code is a 15% discount, not part of the free offer.

offers.name: Kiroween 2026 hackathon credits
offers.value: 4,000 free Kiro credits for Kiroween 2026 hackathon participants, requested on the Resources tab by Dec 1, 2026 12:00 pm PT
offers.summary: Kiro is an agentic AI IDE and CLI from AWS for spec-driven development. Participants in the online Kiroween 2026 hackathon (submissions Oct 30 to Dec 4, 2026, $100,000 in prizes) can request 4,000 free Kiro credits by Dec 1.
offers.who_qualifies: Kiroween 2026 hackathon participants above the age of majority, outside the excluded countries and territories listed in the rules
offers.how_to_claim: Join Kiroween 2026 on Devpost, create a Kiro account, then request credits from the hackathon Resources tab with your Kiro user ID by December 1, 2026 at 12:00 PM PT. Complete the required ID check (selfie and government ID via Didit), and redeem the code by December 4, 2026.
offers.caveats: One-time grant; credits arrive within 48 business hours of the request; redeemed credits expire Dec 31, 2026; many countries excluded (including Australia, Brazil, Italy, Philippines, Russia and the UAE); only new projects built Oct 30 to Dec 4, 2026 count.

offers.name: HeyGen Voice Turbo free API
offers.value: Voice Turbo text-to-speech API free ($0 per million characters) through November 30, no credit card
offers.summary: HeyGen makes AI avatar and video tools and its own text-to-speech models. Its Voice Turbo TTS model is free on the API through November 30 with no credit card, using public voices or instant clones.
offers.how_to_claim: Create a HeyGen account, generate an API key and call the TTS endpoint with the free Turbo model (heygen-voice-1-turbo-free). It is also free on OpenRouter as heygen/heygen-voice-1-turbo:free: use an OpenRouter API key and POST to /api/v1/audio/speech with one of the 10 default voices (voice clones need your own HeyGen key).
offers.caveats: Shared best-effort free capacity with no uptime guarantee; may return 429 when busy. 30 requests per minute per workspace member by default. Public and instant voices only, no professional clones. HeyGen recommends it for tests, prototypes and small amounts of speech.

offers.name: Telemetry free plan
offers.value: Free plan with 30,000 ingestion units a month, 14-day retention, one project and two seats, no credit card
offers.summary: Telemetry is an observability tool for AI agents that traces each run with latency, token usage, cost and errors per model and tool call. Its free plan covers 30,000 ingestion units a month with no credit card.
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at telemetry.dev and connect its SDK or an OpenTelemetry exporter.
offers.caveats: One unit per span, log record or metric data point; ingestion is rejected above 36,000 units a month on Free.

offers.name: Kilo Open Source Sponsorship Program
offers.value: Up to 25 Enterprise seats and up to $200 a month in credits, plus code reviews
offers.summary: Kilo makes Kilo Code, an open source AI coding agent for VS Code, JetBrains and the CLI with code review tools. Selected open source projects get free Enterprise seats, monthly credits and Kilo Code Reviews on their public PRs, with tiers by project size (Premier: 25 seats and up to $200 a month in credits).
offers.who_qualifies: Open source projects with a public repository and a valid OSS license (MIT or equivalent); application-based, tier set by Kilo during review
offers.how_to_claim: Apply on kilo.ai/oss; Kilo reviews applications on a rolling basis and contacts selected projects.
offers.caveats: Tier and credits are set by Kilo during review; Seed tier gets no credits. Code Reviews must run on your public PRs and you agree to be featured in Kilo's marketing.

offers.name: Fish Audio S2.1-Pro Free API Model
offers.value: Free S2.1-Pro text-to-speech API model (s2.1-pro-free) under fair-use limits
offers.summary: Fish Audio is an AI text-to-speech and voice cloning platform with a developer API. Its docs list s2.1-pro-free, the same model as S2.1-Pro at $0 for development and testing under fair-use limits, usable on a new account before adding any API credit.
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up for a free Fish Audio account, create an API key, and call the TTS API with the model header s2.1-pro-free.
offers.caveats: Free through November 30, 2026, per Fish Audio's changelog. Fair-use limits, no latency (TTFA) or DPA guarantees, 5 concurrent requests on the starter tier.

offers.name: Embage Free plan
offers.value: Free plan with 20 AI credits a month, or bring your own key. $0 forever. Includes 3 AI agents, 1 knowledge base, 200 knowledge searches, 500 record saves and 250 app actions a month.
offers.summary: Embage builds AI chat and voice agents for customer support, lead capture and bookings on your website and Telegram. Its Free plan is $0 forever with 20 AI credits a month, or you can bring your own key.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone; no credit card needed. You can use the included 20 AI credits a month or bring your own key.
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up free at embage.com, pick the Free plan (20 AI credits a month), and optionally add your own model API key.
offers.caveats: Free includes 20 AI credits a month, or 0 Embage credits when you add your own key. Voice sessions are not included on Free. Product is in early access.

offers.name: Blinkimg Image API Free Plan
offers.value: 500 image API credits a month
offers.summary: Blinkimg is an image compression and conversion service with a developer API and an MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor. Its free account, no card needed, includes 500 image API credits every month (about 250 images per its pricing page).
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone with a free Blinkimg account; no card needed
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up for a free account at blinkimg.com, then create an API key from the Developer API page. 500 credits are added every month.
offers.caveats: 1 credit per compress, 2 per convert (about 250 images a month with WebP). Credits reset on the 1st. Free uploads are capped at 30 MB.

offers.name: Google Antigravity free plan
offers.value: Free plan with Gemini 3.8 Flash as the agent model, unlimited Tab completions and a weekly-refreshed quota
offers.summary: Google Antigravity is Google's AI coding agent app. Its free plan gives Gemini 3.8 Flash as the core agent model, unlimited Tab completions, access to all product features such as scheduled tasks and the CLI, and a quota refreshed weekly, with no subscription needed.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone with an individual Google account; no Google AI subscription needed
offers.how_to_claim: Download Google Antigravity and sign in with an individual Google account; the free plan applies without a Google AI subscription.
offers.caveats: Per antigravity.google/docs/models, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Opus 4.6 and GPT-OSS-120b leave the free plan on November 30, 2026. Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 need a paid (non-trial) Google AI Pro, Ultra or Enterprise plan. Free quota refreshes weekly and limits can change.

offers.name: Zendesk for Startups
offers.value: Up to 2 years free of Zendesk Suite Professional for up to 50 agents (6 months baseline)
offers.summary: Qualified early-stage startups get Zendesk free for 6 months, extendable to 1 or 2 years through VC and accelerator partners, for up to 50 agents.
offers.who_qualifies: New Zendesk customers with outside funding (Angel to Series B), no more than Series B, under 10 years old, with 50 or fewer employees, or up to 250 if referred by a Zendesk partner
offers.caveats: The baseline term is 6 months; 1 or 2 years only through Zendesk's VC and accelerator partners. Agent count depends on funding profile and partner. The offer terms require outside funding, while the FAQ says bootstrapped startups are welcome. When the free term ends you need a paid plan to keep the account.

offers.name: Oracle AI SMB Bundle
offers.value: US$12,000 in OCI credits per year for up to three years total, plus a one-time US$50 ChatGPT credit per user for up to five users and free tiers of NetSuite QuickStart and Oracle App Composer
offers.summary: Oracle runs Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and NetSuite. Its AI SMB Bundle with OpenAI gives approved small businesses US$12,000 in OCI credits a year for up to three years, a one-time ChatGPT credit, and free tiers of NetSuite QuickStart and Oracle App Composer.
offers.who_qualifies: Small-to-midsize businesses. Availability is limited and each application is reviewed for approval. The current official page does not state a country limit.
offers.how_to_claim: Register your interest through the Apply button on Oracle's AI SMB Bundle page; Oracle then sends a sign-up form.
offers.caveats: Limited availability, each application reviewed. Each benefit has its own limits and terms; the US$12,000 is OCI credit, not cash or OpenAI API credit. Renewal is for up to two more years.

offers.name: Nebius AI Builder Program
offers.value: Free membership with $25 Nebius Token Factory credit, $25 Tavily credit and $50 Toloka credit, plus the Nebius certification for $1
offers.summary: Nebius runs an AI cloud and Token Factory, an inference service for open models. Its free AI Builder Program gives members $25 in Token Factory credit, $25 in Tavily credit and $50 in Toloka credit, plus cookbooks, a free course, office hours and a $1 certification.
offers.who_qualifies: AI builders who join the free Nebius Builder Program (learning, testing, and experimentation focus)
offers.how_to_claim: Join free at https://dev.nebius.com/builders, tell Nebius what you're building, verify your email, then claim the credits for the tools you want.
offers.caveats: Credits are for learning, testing and experimentation, not production. Partner offers depend on each partner's terms and availability. The certification costs $1.

offers.name: Granola Basic free plan
offers.value: Free Basic plan ($0 per user per month): AI meeting notes, AI chat across meetings, shared folders, note templates and voice typing, with 30 days of meeting history
offers.summary: Granola is an AI notepad that writes meeting notes from your device audio without a bot joining the call. Its Basic plan is free per user and includes AI meeting notes, AI chat across meetings and shared folders, with meeting history limited to 30 days.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone - no funding or company stage required
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up for free at granola.ai and download the app; the Basic plan is the default free plan.
offers.caveats: Meeting history is limited to 30 days. API access and integrations like Notion, Zapier and HubSpot need the $14 per user per month Business plan.

offers.name: Embedding Studio $10 free credit
offers.value: $10 of trial credit (5,000 decisions), no card
offers.summary: Embedding Studio fits and calibrates a small model on your own labeled past cases and serves it as an API or a downloadable calibration file, routing low-confidence decisions to a person. New workspaces start with $10 of trial credit (about 5,000 decisions), no card needed.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who creates a new Embedding Studio workspace
offers.caveats: Embedding Studio's credits docs say a new workspace gets $10 of credit with no card, and that $10 is 5,000 decisions. The homepage no longer mentions the trial and leads with a paid annual licence. Trial credit has no cash value stated and is not described as refundable.

offers.name: CloudHike Free Plan
offers.value: $10 in one-time credits on the free plan, valid 90 days
offers.summary: CloudHike is an all-in-one developer backend with managed Postgres, auth, storage, Redis, email, background jobs and an MCP server for AI editors. Its free plan needs no credit card and includes $10 in one-time credits for eligible accounts, valid for 90 days; the post claims $20 for the first 100 signups, which the official page does not show.
offers.who_qualifies: New CloudHike accounts (eligible accounts); free credits are given once per email inbox
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at https://cloudhike.dev/signup with email and password; $10 in credits is added to the new account.
offers.caveats: One-time $10, valid 90 days, once per inbox. The post's $20 for the first 100 signups is not on the official page.

offers.name: Zro free plan with daily usage on Flash coding models
offers.value: Free daily usage on DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, resets every day
offers.summary: Zro by MoonMath.ai is a private inference endpoint for coding agents serving GLM and DeepSeek models with zero request retention. Its free plan gives daily usage on GLM-5.3 Flash and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash through an OpenAI-compatible API.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up for a Zro account and picks the Free plan
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at zro.moonmath.ai, choose the Free plan and copy your API key into your coding tool.
offers.caveats: Daily free amount is not stated. Only DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is free; other models and tools are paid.

offers.name: Runway Free Plan
offers.value: 125 one-time credits
offers.summary: Runway makes AI video and media generation tools. Its Free plan gives a one-time deposit of 125 credits that doesn't expire, a selection of generative creative models and 5GB of asset storage.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up for a free Runway account
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up for a free account at runway.com; the Free plan comes with 125 one-time credits.
offers.caveats: The 125 credits are one time, not monthly, and cover only a selection of models; 5GB storage. All models, no watermarks and 4K upscaling need a paid plan.

offers.name: Genspark Free Plan
offers.value: 100 free credits per day (up to a lifetime allowance)
offers.summary: Genspark is an all-in-one AI workspace for chat, research, slides, docs, sheets, websites, images and video. Its free plan gives 100 credits a day, no card required, until an unstated lifetime allowance of free credits is used up.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone with a free Genspark account
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at genspark.ai for a free account; 100 credits are added each day and work in AI Chat and other Genspark features.
offers.caveats: Daily refills stop after a lifetime allowance of free credits (size not stated). Free accounts have limited model access, with Claude Haiku 4.5 as the default; the post's +1,000 credits for connecting a chat app is not on any official page.

offers.name: Render Free plan
offers.value: 750 free instance hours per workspace per month, free static sites, 1 free Postgres database (1 GB, expires after 30 days) and 1 free Key Value instance
offers.summary: Render is a cloud hosting platform for web apps, APIs, databases and background workers. Its Free plan gives each workspace 750 free instance hours a month plus free static sites, one free 1 GB Postgres database that expires 30 days after creation, and one free Key Value instance.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone with a Render account
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up for Render, click New in the dashboard, pick Web Service, Static Site, Postgres or Key Value, and choose the Free compute plan.
offers.caveats: Free web services spin down after 15 minutes idle. Free Postgres expires after 30 days. Free Key Value data is lost on restart. Not meant for production.

offers.name: Fonoster Cloud free credits
offers.value: 1,000 free credits to start
offers.summary: Fonoster is an open-source platform for building and running voice AI agents on real phone lines, with SIP trunking and bring-your-own model providers. Its pricing page says new Fonoster Cloud accounts start with 1,000 free credits; the founder's post calls the relaunch a preview that may close soon.
offers.who_qualifies: New Fonoster Cloud accounts; no other eligibility rules stated
offers.how_to_claim: Create a Fonoster Cloud account from the pricing page (Start building)
offers.caveats: The pricing page lists one plan, Fonoster Cloud at $25 a month with 2,500 credits a month, and says to start with 1,000 free credits. It does not say whether the free credits need the paid plan or a card, or what a credit is worth in dollars. The founder calls the relaunched cloud a preview that may close.

offers.name: GreenAI Launch
offers.value: Up to $100,000 in GPU credits (up to $25,000 at pre-seed and seed, up to $100,000 at Series A), valid 12 months
offers.summary: GREENAIBOX is a GPU cloud offering on-demand NVIDIA GPU instances and clusters. Its GreenAI Launch startup program gives eligible AI startups up to $100,000 in GPU Cloud or cluster credits valid for 12 months, with no equity, lock-in or minimum spend.
offers.who_qualifies: Companies under five years old with under $25M total funding building an AI product
offers.how_to_claim: Apply through the startup contact form at https://www.greenaibox.com/contact?topic=startup.
offers.caveats: Up to $25,000 for pre-seed and seed; up to $100,000 only for Series A companies scaling training. Credits valid 12 months on GPU Cloud or cluster usage. Applications reviewed, decisions within five business days.

offers.name: Wiro for Startups
offers.value: Up to $5,000 in API credits ($200 pre-revenue, $1,000 funded, $5,000 live products)
offers.summary: Wiro is a generative AI API platform with 1000+ image, video, audio and language models behind one API and an OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway. Its startup program gives approved startups $200 to $5,000 in API credits by stage, with no card needed to apply and a reply within 24 hours.
offers.who_qualifies: Startups with a company or product. Tier set by manual review from product stage, funding and monthly AI spend: $200 pre-revenue, $1,000 funded, $5,000 live products with real AI spend.
offers.how_to_claim: Create a Wiro account, then press Apply for credits on wiro.ai/startups and send the prefilled chat message with your company, website, stage, monthly AI spend and what you are building. Wiro replies within 24 hours.

offers.name: HostEdge Free plan
offers.value: Free for 3 projects, no card: 1 custom domain, 100,000 requests and 10 GB bandwidth per month, 1 GB data stored
offers.summary: HostEdge is edge hosting built for AI agents, letting Claude, Cursor or any MCP agent deploy, read logs and roll back. The Free plan covers 3 projects with 100,000 requests and 10 GB bandwidth a month, no card needed.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at hostedge.app and deploy on the Free plan; no card needed.
offers.caveats: Sites over the monthly request allowance show an over-limit page until the month resets or you upgrade. New free accounts' first sites get an abuse check before going live. 10 ms CPU time per request on Free.

offers.name: Cartesia free plan
offers.value: 20K credits per month for text to speech and speech to text, plus $1 of prepaid voice agent usage per month (about 33 minutes at $0.03/min)
offers.summary: Cartesia makes voice AI models and APIs for text to speech, speech to text and voice agents. Its free plan gives 20K credits a month plus $1 of prepaid voice agent usage; a commercial use license starts on the $5/mo Pro plan.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up for the Free plan; non-commercial use only
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at cartesia.ai and use the Free plan
offers.caveats: No commercial use license on Free (starts on the $5/mo Pro plan). Agent minutes exclude telephony and LLM usage, which is billed separately (free for a limited time).

offers.name: Postman for AI-native Startups
offers.value: Free Team plan for 3 months plus 25,000 Agent Stack AI Credits
offers.summary: Postman is an API platform for designing, testing and running APIs, now with an Agent Stack for AI agents. Its new startup program gives funded AI-native startups the Team plan free for their whole team for 3 months plus 25,000 AI Credits valid for 3 months, with extensions possible.
offers.who_qualifies: Institutionally funded AI-native startups founded after 2020, headquartered in the US or Canada, new to Postman as a paying customer; one grant per company
offers.how_to_claim: Submit the contact form on the program page; Postman verifies your funding and fit, then you sign a short program agreement and they set up seats and credits
offers.caveats: Moves automatically to the paid Team plan at list price after 3 months unless you cancel. Credits cover usage only, expire 3 months after activation and are at Postman's discretion.

offers.name: Novita AI for Startups
offers.value: Up to $10,000 in credits for Model APIs and Agent Sandbox: up to $1,000 upfront, the next $5,000 matched 1:1 on spend and the last $4,000 at $1 per $2 spent, redeemable for one year
offers.summary: Novita AI is a model API, GPU cloud and agent sandbox platform. Its startup program gives venture-backed, AI-native startups at Series B or earlier that are new Novita users up to $10,000 in credits, partly upfront and the rest matched to spend.
offers.who_qualifies: Venture-backed startups at Series B or earlier with an AI-native product that are new Novita users
offers.how_to_claim: Apply with the form on the Novita AI for Startups page (startups.novita.ai); Novita reviews each application.

offers.name: Arcade free plan
offers.value: 2,000 tool calls a month free, $0 platform fee, no credit card required
offers.summary: Arcade is a tool-calling platform that lets AI agents take real actions in other apps. Its Free plan includes 2,000 tool calls a month on Arcade Cloud with no platform fee and no card.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up for the Free plan
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up for free at arcade.dev; the Free plan needs no credit card.

offers.name: Axiom Personal free plan
offers.value: Personal plan at $0 a month, permanent, no credit card: 500 GB/mo data loading compute, 10 GB-hours query compute, 25 GB storage, 30-day retention, full APL access and all integrations
offers.summary: Axiom is a log, event and observability data platform with an MCP server so AI assistants can query it. Its permanent Personal plan is free for individual developers and small projects, with 500 GB/mo of ingest compute and 25 GB storage.
offers.who_qualifies: Individual developers and small projects, no credit card required
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up for the Personal plan via Start Free on https://axiom.co/pricing

offers.name: Modaal Free plan
offers.value: Free plan: 1 active project, unlimited prompts, one platform (iOS or Android), bring your own AI agent, no card
offers.summary: Modaal is a macOS AI app builder that writes native Swift and Kotlin apps for iOS and Android with your own AI coding agent. Its free plan, with no card required, covers one active project on one platform with unlimited prompts.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone; no card required
offers.how_to_claim: Download the Modaal app for Mac from modaal.dev and start on the Free plan; no card required.
offers.caveats: macOS on Apple Silicon only, Xcode needed for iOS. You bring and pay for your own coding agent. Free covers one platform; iOS plus Android together and App Store distribution need Pro.

offers.name: Cloudflare Workers AI free allocation
offers.value: 10,000 Neurons per day free on Workers AI, on both the Workers Free and Paid plans
offers.summary: Cloudflare Workers AI runs open AI models on Cloudflare's serverless GPU network. Anyone gets a free allocation of 10,000 Neurons a day, resetting at 00:00 UTC, with some models requiring a paid billing method.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone with a Cloudflare account
offers.how_to_claim: Create a free Cloudflare account and call Workers AI from a Worker or the REST API; the daily free allocation applies automatically.

offers.name: Wealthnow financial data API and MCP free tier
offers.value: 1,000 free API credits a month
offers.summary: Wealthnow offers a financial data REST API and a hosted read-only MCP server that lets AI agents such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Codex pull quotes, fundamentals and SEC filings. Its Free plan gives 1,000 credits a month, shared by the API and the MCP server, with no card required.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone with a free Wealthnow account; no card needed for the free tier
offers.how_to_claim: Get a free API key on wealthnow.io/api, or add the MCP server https://mcp.wealthnow.io/mcp to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Codex and sign in with OAuth.
offers.caveats: Free plan covers market data, fundamentals and SEC filings only, at 30 requests per minute. Congress trades, 13F, insider data and news need Starter ($99/mo).

offers.name: AdLib API Free plan
offers.value: Start with 2,000 free credits, then buy credits when you need them: no subscription, valid for 12 months. Free credits to start: 2,000, once per account. The free credits are given once per account and don't expire. No card.
offers.summary: AdLib is one REST API and MCP server over public ad libraries. New accounts get 2,000 free API credits once, with no card. Free credits do not expire. After that, usage is prepaid credit packs valid for 12 months.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up for an AdLib account
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at adlibapi.com and claim the 2,000 free API credits. No card needed.
offers.expiry: ongoing (free credits are given once per account and do not expire; purchased credits stay valid for 12 months)
offers.caveats: The 2,000 free credits are one-time, not a monthly refill. Purchased packs last 12 months. Archive history is 12 months until a pack is bought.

offers.name: Botscanner LLM Router $1 free credit
offers.value: $1 in free credits, no credit card required
offers.summary: Botscanner, built by AutoBench, is an LLM router with an OpenAI-compatible API that sends each prompt to the cheapest model that answers it well. New accounts get a $1 free credit invitation code with no credit card required.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up at botscanner.ai; no credit card required
offers.how_to_claim: On botscanner.ai, click Get your $1 Free Credit Invitation Code, sign up with the code, then use the router in chat or create an OpenAI-compatible API key (base URL https://api.autobench.org/v1).
offers.caveats: Free accounts start on the Cost routing mode; Quality and Balanced unlock at Tier 1. The router is in beta.

offers.name: Scenario free tier - 50 free daily credits
offers.value: 50 free daily credits, no credit card required
offers.summary: Scenario is an AI platform where creative and game studios generate and manage image, video, 3D and audio assets across leading models, with workflows, agents and an MCP server. Its free tier gives 50 free daily credits to try every model, with no credit card required.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at scenario.com with the Get Started button; the free tier gives 50 credits and needs no credit card.
offers.caveats: Free plan outputs are for personal and evaluation use only; a commercial license needs a paid plan. Credits don't roll over. The source post is Scenario's own brand post linking to the site; the free-tier terms come from the official pricing page, not the post.

offers.name: Bivia launch offer: 1 billion free tokens
offers.value: 1 billion tokens free for the first 10,000 users, no subscription
offers.summary: Articul8 builds enterprise generative AI, and Bivia is its compact multimodal decision model that returns calibrated, structured decisions instead of generated text. As a launch offer, the first 10,000 users get 1 billion tokens free with no subscription.
offers.who_qualifies: First 10,000 users who register on the Articul8 platform
offers.how_to_claim: On the Bivia page, click Claim yours and register on the Articul8 platform (https://app.articul8.ai/registration?source=bivia&code=bivia), then create an API key.
offers.caveats: Launch offer for the first 10,000 users only; the page does not say how many slots remain or whether the tokens expire.

offers.name: Zed Student Plan
offers.value: Zed Pro free for 12 months, including $10/month in AI token credits and unlimited edit predictions
offers.summary: Zed is a fast, collaborative code editor with built-in AI agents. Verified university students aged 18+ get Zed Pro free for one year, with $10 a month in AI token credits and unlimited edit predictions, then drop to the free plan.
offers.who_qualifies: University students aged 18+ worldwide, with a GitHub account older than 30 days and a current university email
offers.how_to_claim: Go to zed.dev/education, sign in with GitHub and submit your current university email for verification.
offers.caveats: Excludes Claude Fable, Claude Opus and GPT Pro models. Downgrades to the Free plan after 12 months.

offers.name: API credits for ChatGPT Pro and Business subscribers
offers.value: Up to $500 a month in OpenAI API credits: $100, $200 or $500 on Pro tiers, $20 per Business Standard seat and $100 per Business Premium seat (Business capped at $500 per workspace per month)
offers.summary: OpenAI makes the GPT models and the OpenAI API. Eligible ChatGPT Pro and Business subscribers can link their subscription to an API organization and get up to $500 a month in free API credits that renew each billing cycle.
offers.who_qualifies: Owners of an active, paid ChatGPT Pro or Business subscription at least seven days old who also own the linked API organization with the same email; free trials and complimentary subscriptions don't qualify
offers.how_to_claim: In ChatGPT open Settings, then Billing (or the Business admin billing settings), or in the API Platform open Billing, and link the subscription to an API organization you own
offers.caveats: Needs a paid ChatGPT Pro or Business plan at least seven days old; Plus, Go, Free and Enterprise do not qualify. Credits expire at the end of each billing cycle and don't roll over; the first grant is prorated. Business credits are capped at $500 per workspace per month, or $6,000 per annual billing cycle when paid annually (full year granted in one issuance). No API payment method needed; with no paid balance, requests fail with HTTP 429 once free credits run out. Codex usage through API keys isn't covered, and the credits don't raise ChatGPT or Codex limits.

offers.name: OpenCode Zen free models
offers.value: Current free models (free input and output): Big Pickle, Iceman Free, Inkling 2 Small Free, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free, Beam Free, Flint 40B Free, LongCat 2.5 Free, Hy4 flash Free, MiMo-V2.6-Flash Free, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning Free, Nemotron 3.5 Super VL Free, and Jev 1.13 Free. GLM-5.3-Flash Free was deprecated on November 18, 2026 and is no longer in the free table.
offers.summary: OpenCode Console is the OpenCode team's curated, pay-as-you-go model gateway for coding agents. Its docs list a set of free-tier models with free input and output tokens, which require the OpenCode client.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone with an OpenCode sign-in; free models work only from the OpenCode client
offers.how_to_claim: Sign in to OpenCode, pick a model ending in Free (or Big Pickle) with /models, and use it from the OpenCode client
offers.caveats: Free for a limited time with no single end date. Free chat models need the OpenCode client. Some free models may log or train on your data during the free period. Beam Free is blocked in some countries, and Inkling 2 Small Free is not available in the EU, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Russia, Ukraine or Venezuela. LongCat 2.5 Free is limited to 100 requests per day and is hosted in China. GLM-5.3-Flash Free was deprecated November 18, 2026, Pulse Alpha Free on November 6, 2026 and Crouton Alpha Free on November 9, 2026.

offers.name: AI for Church Hackathon - 100 free Lovable credits
offers.value: 100 free Lovable credits for every participant
offers.summary: AI for Church runs a free, fully online hackathon for building AI software that serves churches, with a $2,500 cash prize pool. Every registered participant gets 100 free credits on Lovable, the AI app builder, plus 3 months half off Magai. The build window runs October 30 to November 27, 2026.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone 18 or older worldwide; applications are reviewed
offers.how_to_claim: Register free on the AI for Church hackathon page, build your project between October 30 and November 27, 2026, and submit by 11:59 PM ET on November 27.
offers.caveats: Applications are reviewed, and incomplete, low-effort or ineligible applications are denied. Credit delivery timing and credit expiry are not stated.

offers.name: Microsoft Copilot harness in Foundry - free preview runtime
offers.value: Harness runtime free until December 1, 2026 (model inference billed separately)
offers.summary: Microsoft Foundry is Microsoft's managed platform for building and running AI agents. The Copilot harness, the multi-model agent runtime behind GitHub Copilot and VS Code, is now in public preview in Foundry Agent Service, and harness runtime usage is free until December 1, 2026; model inference and connected tools are still billed.
offers.who_qualifies: Any Microsoft Foundry customer with an Azure subscription who creates a prompt agent using the Copilot harness
offers.how_to_claim: In Microsoft Foundry Agent Service, create an agent and select the Microsoft Copilot harness during the public preview; no separate sign-up is described.
offers.caveats: The free window covers harness runtime only. Model inference and separately billed tools and connected services are still charged. From December 1, 2026 sandbox compute is billed at $0.0994 per vCPU-hour and memory at $0.0118 per GiB-hour.

offers.name: TravelTime free Basic plan
offers.value: Free Basic plan with every API endpoint, 120 hits per minute and up to 10,000 Geocoding, Map Tiles and Data API requests, no credit card
offers.summary: TravelTime is a location and travel-time API (matrix, isochrones, routing, geocoding and the new Data API for POIs, transport and population). Its free Basic plan gives a developer key for every endpoint, free forever for research, development and evaluation, with no credit card.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone, for research, development and evaluation only (not commercial use)
offers.how_to_claim: Get a free developer API key at traveltime.com.
offers.caveats: Not for commercial use, including internal commercial work and public sector use; production needs a paid plan with a 12-month minimum. Basic is capped at 120 hits per minute and up to 10,000 Geocoding, Map Tiles and Data API requests.

offers.name: Gnani AI free credits
offers.value: 1,000+ free credits for Gnani AI speech APIs with every new account
offers.summary: Gnani AI offers speech-to-text, text-to-speech and voice agent models for Indian languages via API, including the new Prisma v3.0 speech-to-text model for noisy, code-mixed call audio. Every new account comes with 1,000+ free credits.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up at app.gnani.ai
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at app.gnani.ai, then use the credits in the playground or create an API key from the dashboard.
offers.caveats: The official page does not say how many audio minutes the credits cover. Usage after that is billed per hour of audio. Playground clips are limited to 30 seconds.

offers.name: Napster Hackathon at Microsoft Ignite
offers.value: $250 in Napster API credits for every entrant who completes a hackathon submission
offers.summary: Napster is an agentic AI platform whose API puts agents with video, voice and memory into apps, sites and phone lines. Its virtual Microsoft Ignite hackathon (entries open until Nov 30, 2026) gives $250 in Napster API credits to every entrant who completes a submission, with $500 to $1,000 in credits plus hardware for the top three.
offers.who_qualifies: Developers worldwide aged 18+, except sanctioned jurisdictions and Quebec
offers.how_to_claim: Register on the hackathon page at napster.com/microsoftignite26, build an agent on the Napster API, and submit a hosted demo, short video, repo link and written summary by Nov 30, 2026 (11:59 PM PT).
offers.caveats: Credits are only for completed submissions; signup credits are contest-scoped and revoked when the contest ends.

offers.name: VideoGen Model 1 free AI credits
offers.value: Share of a $1M free AI credit pool
offers.summary: VideoGen is a Y Combinator-backed AI video company whose Model 1 turns a prompt and optional images into finished multi-shot videos up to ten minutes long. It is handing out a $1M pool of free credits to approved creative projects, with allocations based on project scope and distribution plan.
offers.who_qualifies: Filmmakers, creators and studios making and sharing work; students and amateurs welcome; some credits for journalists and software reviewers. Approval required.
offers.how_to_claim: On the Model 1 page, sign in, select Request access and describe your project, distribution plan and capacity needed.

offers.name: Supermicro JumpStart free remote server access
offers.value: Free time-limited remote access to bare-metal GPU servers (NVIDIA HGX B300, B200, H200, AMD Instinct MI350P and others)
offers.summary: Supermicro builds data center and AI servers. Its JumpStart program gives free, time-limited remote sessions (SSH, VNC, IPMI) on bare-metal systems including NVIDIA HGX B300/B200/H200 and AMD Instinct MI350P GPU servers to validate and benchmark your own workloads.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone with a free Supermicro SSO account can request a system and timeslot; access depends on availability and Supermicro's approval
offers.how_to_claim: Go to https://www.supermicro.com/en/jumpstart, click Get Access, pick a system and timeslot, then sign in with a Supermicro SSO account (or create a free one). Credentials and instructions come with the server.
offers.caveats: Limited-time sessions of unstated length, subject to availability and Supermicro's approval. One VNC, one SSH and one IPMI session per server. No sensitive data; nothing is backed up and the server is wiped after each session. Supermicro can change or end the program at any time.

offers.name: Vapi free credits
offers.value: $5 free credits
offers.summary: Vapi is a developer platform for building, testing and deploying AI voice agents. New accounts get $5 in free credits to start, then pay per minute.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up for a Vapi account
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up for a Vapi account at vapi.ai; the $5 starter credit is included on the pay-as-you-go plan.
offers.caveats: One-time $5 credit. After that, usage is pre-paid at $0.05/min Vapi hosting plus model, transcriber and voice costs at cost.

offers.name: Parallel Decisions API
offers.value: Up to 5,000 free requests a month ($5 monthly free credit) covering the Decisions API from $1 per 1k requests ($0.001 each), plus up to $80 at signup and up to $250 for qualified startups
offers.summary: Parallel Web Systems launched the Decisions API, which answers typed questions about a company or topic from live web sources in one call for $0.001 per request. Parallel's free tier gives up to 5,000 requests a month, so you can run 5,000 Decisions calls a month at no cost.
offers.who_qualifies: Any developer who signs up; the recurring $5 monthly free credit needs a card on file. The $250 startup credits are for qualified startups that apply.
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at https://platform.parallel.ai/ to get the monthly free credits. Startups apply for up to $250 at https://form.fillout.com/t/cNxJPKmh7eus. The Decisions API is also free through Parallel's MCP server (web_decisions tool) with no key.
offers.caveats: The Decisions API is paid beyond the free monthly credit. How the up to $80 signup bonus is earned is not stated. Startup credits need an application.

offers.name: 3AM Super Intelligence 90-day free trial
offers.value: 90-day free trial during the current offer (normally 30 days), covering up to 50 services and 10 installs
offers.summary: 3AM is a self-hosted AI on-call engineer that investigates production incidents, confirms root causes with live checks and proposes fixes for human approval. During its open alpha, trial codes run 90 days instead of 30 and cover up to 50 services and 10 installs.
offers.who_qualifies: Any company evaluating 3AM, one trial per company email domain (work email needed)
offers.how_to_claim: Run the installer with --trial on a Linux server (curl -fsSL https://get.3am.si/install | sh -s -- --trial), enter your work email, and paste the trial code sent by email. See https://docs.3am.si/getting-started/quickstart
offers.caveats: One trial per company email domain; the 90-day length is a current offer that 3AM can end at any time; no grace period, the software enters setup mode when the trial ends; self-hosted, needs your own server and model hosting; no public pricing after the trial.

offers.name: HasData Free plan
offers.value: 1,000 API credits every month, free, no credit card
offers.summary: HasData offers web scraping and data APIs (Google SERP, Zillow and more) plus no-code scrapers and a hosted MCP server for AI agents. Its free plan gives 1,000 credits every month with access to every tool, 5 concurrent requests and no credit card required.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up for a HasData account
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up for free at hasdata.com - the Free plan is applied without a card.
offers.caveats: Calls cost 1 to 15 credits depending on the tool, so Google SERP or MCP calls use 5 to 10 credits each.

offers.name: EcomGen 250 free credits
offers.value: 250 free credits on signup, no card needed; free credits are valid for 15 days from signup
offers.summary: EcomGen is an AI fashion production studio that turns product photos into model shoots, catalogue images, videos and ad creatives with no prompt writing. Every new account gets 250 free credits with no card needed, valid for 15 days from signup.
offers.who_qualifies: New accounts
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up for a new account at ecomgen.io
offers.caveats: Free credits are valid for 15 days from signup. A basic 5-photo product shoot costs 138 credits on the official page, so 250 credits cover about one to two products. Plans start at 1,299 rupees a month. The X post calls it limited time.

offers.name: Popcraft 100 free credits
offers.value: 100 free credits to try, no card
offers.summary: Popcraft is an AI content platform for generating video, images, audio and avatars with many models, usable from the web or from AI agents through its MCP server. New accounts get 100 free credits to try it, no card needed.
offers.who_qualifies: New Popcraft accounts
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up for a free Popcraft account; the MCP connector also works on the free tier
offers.caveats: Free tier runs one job at a time at 720p up to 5 seconds, outputs are watermarked and for personal use, there is no monthly allowance, and some premium models are reserved for paid plans.

offers.name: Fathom free plan
offers.value: Free forever plan with unlimited recordings, instant call summaries and LLM integrations
offers.summary: Fathom is an AI meeting note-taker that records calls and writes summaries and action items. Its free forever plan includes unlimited recordings, instant call summaries and integrations with LLMs.
offers.who_qualifies: Individuals
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up free at fathom.ai

offers.name: Browserbase free plan
offers.value: Free plan: 1 browser hour, 3 agent runs, 1,000 search and 1,000 fetch calls, $5 in model tokens
offers.summary: Browserbase is a platform for building and running agents that browse the web. Its $0 free plan includes 3 concurrent browsers, 1 browser hour, 3 agent runs, 1,000 search calls, 1,000 fetch calls and $5 in model tokens.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up for a free account at https://www.browserbase.com/sign-up
offers.caveats: Free plan sessions are capped at 15 minutes and you get 3 concurrent browsers.

offers.name: Free use of SWE-2 in Devin
offers.value: Free use of the SWE-2 model in Devin Desktop and Devin CLI on paid self-serve plans (Pro $20/month and up), through November 30, 2026
