offers.summary: Devin is an AI coding agent from Cognition with desktop, CLI and cloud agents. Its Pro plan ($20 per month) and higher plans include free use of SWE-2, Devin's latest coding model, in Devin Desktop and Devin CLI through November 30, 2026. The Free plan only gets SWE-1.6.
offers.who_qualifies: Paid Devin self-serve subscribers (Pro, Max, Teams); Free plan users only get SWE-1.6
offers.how_to_claim: Subscribe to Devin Pro or higher at https://devin.ai/pricing and pick SWE-2 in the model selector
offers.caveats: Free SWE-2 covers Devin Desktop and Devin CLI only, not Devin Cloud sessions. After November 30, 2026, list pricing applies ($3.00 per 1M input, $15.00 per 1M output, $0.30 per 1M cache input tokens). Needs a paid plan; Free plan users only get SWE-1.6. SWE-2 Flash is free for self-serve plans in Devin Desktop and Devin CLI until December 4, 2026 at 18:00 UTC; afterward it costs $0.10 per 1M input, $0.01 per 1M cache reads, $0.125 per 1M cache writes and $0.50 per 1M output tokens. Free plans can select SWE-2 Flash Medium.

offers.name: Gemini API Free Tier
offers.value: Free input and output tokens on eligible Gemini and Gemma models, including Gemini 4 Hydrogen (gemini-4-hydrogen), with rate limits
offers.summary: Google's Gemini API lets developers build with Gemini and Gemma models through Google AI Studio. The free tier gives free-of-charge input, output and implicit context caching on eligible models, including Gemini 4 Hydrogen (gemini-4-hydrogen), with rate limits.
offers.who_qualifies: Any developer with a Google account using Google AI Studio; some free tier projects and accounts require mobile device verification
offers.how_to_claim: Sign in to Google AI Studio at https://aistudio.google.com/ and create a free API key. If a free tier project shows Verification needed or the API returns 403 FREE_TIER_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED, complete the mobile QR verification at the link Google shows (docs: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/verification).
offers.caveats: Some free tier projects need mobile QR device verification on a physical phone, or return 403 FREE_TIER_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED. Not every model is on the Free tier: Gemini 4 Carbon and Gemini 4 Argon are not available. On Gemini 4 Hydrogen, input, output and implicit context caching are free of charge, but Grounding with Google Search and Maps is not available on the Free tier, and Batch and Flex are not available. On the Free tier, content is used to improve Google's products. Rate limits apply per project and can be viewed in Google AI Studio; specified limits are not guaranteed. Paid tier skips verification.

offers.name: Enricho Free plan
offers.value: 100 free credits on signup (up to 100 results), never expire; no card
offers.summary: Enricho is a data API and MCP server that gives AI agents people, company, job, gig and social profile data. New accounts get 100 free credits that never expire, with no card needed.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone, no card needed
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at enricho.co - no card needed - and connect the MCP server or use an API key
offers.caveats: A company, job, gig or social profile costs 1 credit; a person record costs 2 credits. 100 free credits therefore cover up to 100 results, or 50 person records. Previews are free. Free credits are one-time on signup, not a monthly refill. Bought credits never expire.

offers.name: Reachira free AI credits
offers.value: 100 free AI credits on the Free plan, no card
offers.summary: Reachira turns your App Store or website link into short-form product videos and can schedule posts. New Free accounts get 100 AI credits to start, with no card.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up for Reachira
offers.how_to_claim: Click Start free on reachira.com and sign up for the Free plan; it needs no card and starts with 100 AI credits.
offers.caveats: Free plan videos may include a Reachira watermark. Paid Growth starts higher; the 7-day Growth trial requires a card.

offers.name: Microlink API free plan
offers.value: 25 requests per day with a free API key, up to 2 concurrent requests, no card required
offers.summary: Microlink is an API that turns any URL into structured output such as screenshots, PDFs, metadata, markdown and HTML. Its new free plan gives a free API key with 25 requests a day and every Pro feature, no card required.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up for a free API key
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at https://dashboard.microlink.io/signup to get a free API key, then send it as a header with API calls.

offers.name: TinyFish for Startups
offers.value: Up to $12,000 in value
offers.summary: TinyFish, web infrastructure for AI agents, runs a startup program worth up to $12,000. TinySearch and TinyFetch are free for everyone; Tier 1 adds $100 in Wallet funds every month for 6 months plus 4x Search and Fetch rate limits, and Tier 2 gives $500 in Wallet funds, 4x rate limits for a year and 50% off TinyAgent and TinyBrowser for 24 months.
offers.who_qualifies: Tier 1 (up to $7,000): independent teams not in an accelerator or backed by investors, still pre-production (idea, prototype or private beta). Tier 2 (up to $12,000): startups backed by an accelerator, VC or angels, at any product stage, with proof (batch page, program profile or funding news).
offers.how_to_claim: Apply on tinyfish.ai/startups and pick a tier. Questions go to accelerator@tinyfish.ai.
offers.caveats: Application based, with two tiers by funding and product stage; approval is not guaranteed. Tier 2 needs proof of accelerator or investor backing. A verified business email domain is required, one application per company. Wallet credits expire at the end of the window and Tier 1 funds do not roll over. Tier 1 rate limits: 120 searches and 600 Fetch URLs a minute plus 50 concurrent TinyAgent and TinyBrowser runs for 6 months; Tier 2: 120 searches and 600 Fetch URLs a minute for 12 months.
offers.why_it_matters: Both tiers also include a blog and social feature, founder dinner invites and a direct line to TinyFish engineers.

offers.name: Gyaansetu free plan
offers.value: 1,000 free credits every month
offers.summary: Gyaansetu is a web search API for AI agents that reads the pages it finds and returns the passages that answer a query, each with a relevance score. The free plan gives 1,000 credits every month with no card required.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone with a Google account; no card needed
offers.how_to_claim: Sign in with Google at web-search.gyaansetu.com and create an API key
offers.caveats: An advanced search costs 2 credits and a basic search 1 credit.

offers.name: Strawberry Free Plan
offers.value: Free plan with 500 monthly credits
offers.summary: Strawberry is an AI browser for Mac and Windows with built-in AI companions that research, automate tabs, take meeting notes and draft follow-ups for teams. Its free plan gives 500 monthly credits with curated AI models.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up
offers.how_to_claim: Download Strawberry and choose Try for free on the pricing page to start on the Free plan.
offers.caveats: Credits are used only when AI companions act; browsing is free. Plan credits refresh monthly and don't roll over.

offers.name: LiveKit Startup Program
offers.value: Up to $23K: one year of the Scale plan ($6,000), $10,000 in Cloud credits and $7,000 in inference credits ($1K each from 7 partners)
offers.summary: LiveKit is a realtime platform for building voice, video and physical AI agents, with agent hosting, observability and telephony. Its startup program gives up to $23K, including a free year of the Scale plan, $10K in Cloud credits and $7K in partner inference credits.
offers.who_qualifies: Startups where voice, video or physical AI is core to the product, fewer than 50 employees, under $5M raised and pre-Series A ($5M+ reviewed case-by-case), with a live website and a publicly identifiable founding team
offers.how_to_claim: Apply on the LiveKit startups page
offers.caveats: A card on file is required to enroll. Credits expire 12 months from issuance and do not roll over. Inference credits only work on the partner models they were granted for. Teams long on LiveKit or already paying may be declined. YC companies apply through livekit.com/yc instead, and the two offers can't be combined.

offers.name: NVIDIA Inception
offers.value: Free cloud credits from NVIDIA and partners (amount not stated), preferred pricing on select NVIDIA hardware and software, partner offers, free self-paced courses and investor access
offers.summary: NVIDIA Inception is a free program that guides AI startups through the NVIDIA platform and ecosystem. Members get free cloud credits from NVIDIA and partners, preferred pricing on select NVIDIA hardware and software, partner offers and investor access.
offers.who_qualifies: Incorporated startups under 10 years old with a working website, a clear use case for NVIDIA technology and at least one active founder; revenue and funding not required
offers.how_to_claim: Apply on the NVIDIA Inception page
offers.caveats: The official page does not state a credit amount. The company must be incorporated to apply; revenue and funding are not required.

offers.name: Oxylabs Web API free credits
offers.value: $5 in welcome credits toward any Oxylabs product
offers.summary: Oxylabs Web API gives AI agents live web search and scraping through one API, with Search and Scrape endpoints, an MCP server and LLM-ready JSON or Markdown output. Every new user gets a free trial with $5 in credits and no time limit.
offers.who_qualifies: New Oxylabs users
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up for free on the Web API page
offers.caveats: Credits are a one-time welcome amount; paid plans start at $15 per month.

offers.name: Pomerado Free plan
offers.value: Free plan: 100 tool calls per day and 10 new integrations per month, with automatic sign-in including 2FA
offers.summary: Pomerado is an open-source tool that turns any website into a hosted API or MCP server for AI agents, faster and more reliable than browser agents. Its Free plan gives 100 tool calls per day and 10 new integrations per month at $0.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone; no account needed to try the keyless MCP
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at pomerado.ai or add the keyless MCP server
offers.caveats: 1 account per website on the Free plan

offers.name: Hark Pro free plan
offers.value: Free plan with the full feature set, usage capped
offers.summary: Hark is an AI assistant that uses its own cloud computer and memory to handle tasks like email, Slack tracking, scheduling, docs and web errands. Hark Pro is free on web, iOS and Android with the full feature set, up to a usage cap.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up for Hark
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up on hark.com with Google, Apple or email, or download the iOS or Android app
offers.caveats: Free use has an unpublished usage cap; paid tiers are $20/mo for 2x usage and $100/mo for 10x usage.

offers.name: Groq Free Plan
offers.value: Free API access with per-model limits, e.g. gpt-oss-120b at 30 requests a minute, 1,000 requests and 200K tokens a day
offers.summary: Groq runs fast LLM inference on its own chips and offers it through an API. Its Free Plan gives API access to hosted models like gpt-oss-120b, Qwen and Whisper at no cost, within per-model daily request and token limits.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone with a free GroqCloud account
offers.how_to_claim: Create a free account at console.groq.com and generate an API key. A payment method is only needed to upgrade to the Developer plan.
offers.caveats: Limits differ per model; the post's 200K tokens and 1,000 requests a day match gpt-oss and Qwen models on the Free Plan.

offers.name: Valyu free signup credits
offers.value: 2,000 free credits a month with a work email; personal emails get 1,000 credits to start, then monthly with a card
offers.summary: Valyu offers search and DeepResearch APIs for AI agents. The free tier now gives 2,000 credits a month with a work email. Personal emails get 1,000 credits to start, then a monthly refill with a card.
offers.who_qualifies: New Valyu accounts. A work email gets 2,000 credits a month. A personal email gets 1,000 credits to start, then a monthly refill with a card.
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at valyu.ai. Use a work email for 2,000 free credits a month. A personal email gets 1,000 credits to start, then monthly with a card.
offers.caveats: This replaced the earlier $10 / $20 signup-credit wording. At 1,600 credits per $10, 2,000 credits is about $12.50 of usage and 1,000 credits is about $6.25. After the first 1,000 credits, monthly free access is Web, arXiv and PubMed. Personal emails need a card for the monthly refill.

offers.name: Cerebras Free Trial Credits
offers.value: $5 in free credits after adding a verified payment method; credits expire 30 days after grant
offers.summary: Cerebras runs very fast LLM inference on its wafer-scale chips through a cloud API. New accounts get $5 in free credits on the Free Trial tier, usable across all public models for 30 days.
offers.who_qualifies: New Cerebras Inference accounts that add a verified payment method
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up for Cerebras Cloud and add a verified payment method
offers.expiry: ongoing (each grant expires 30 days after issued)
offers.caveats: Requires a verified payment method to claim. Credits expire 30 days after grant. No charge until you buy more.

offers.name: Cohere free trial API key
offers.value: Free evaluation API key, limited to 1,000 API calls a month
offers.summary: Cohere builds enterprise language models such as Command, Embed and Rerank. Its free trial API key lets developers call these models for evaluation, capped at 1,000 API calls a month with per-model rate limits such as 20 chat requests a minute.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up for a Cohere account
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up on the Cohere dashboard and create a trial key on the API keys page
offers.caveats: Trial keys are for evaluation, not production use.

offers.name: KonbiniAPI free credits
offers.value: 100 free API credits on signup
offers.summary: KonbiniAPI is a social media data API that returns normalized public data from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, X and LinkedIn over REST and MCP. New users get 100 free credits on the Mini plan with no credit card, where one standard request costs one credit.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up on the Mini plan; no credit card needed
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up for a free API key on the Mini plan, no credit card needed.
offers.caveats: The 100 free credits are one-time and don't refill. Credits beyond the free 100 are pay as you go at $20 for 5,000.

offers.name: SiteSpeakAI Free plan
offers.value: Free plan: 1 AI agent, 30 message credits per month, 10 training sources, basic AI models, live chat widget
offers.summary: SiteSpeakAI builds AI support agents trained on your website, docs, PDFs and videos that answer visitors, capture leads and hand off to live chat. Its Free plan costs $0 with no credit card and no time limit, and includes 1 AI agent, 30 message credits a month and 10 training sources.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone; no credit card needed
offers.how_to_claim: Select Get Started Free on the pricing page and register; no credit card needed
offers.caveats: Free plan uses basic AI models only. Paid plans have a separate 7-day free trial.

offers.name: deAPI free credits
offers.value: $5 in free credits for new users
offers.summary: deAPI is a single API for 100+ open-source generative AI models for images, video, speech, transcription and embeddings, run on a distributed GPU network. New users get $5 in free credits with no credit card required.
offers.who_qualifies: New deAPI users
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at deapi.ai and verify your email, then use the Playground or create an API key.
offers.caveats: Usage is paid after the free credit runs out.

offers.name: Sarvam Startup Program
offers.value: 6 to 12 months of API credits, amount depends on scale
offers.summary: Sarvam's startup program gives AI startups 6 to 12 months of API credits, priority support and launch visibility for its speech, vision and LLM APIs covering 22 Indian languages plus English.
offers.who_qualifies: AI startups building on Sarvam's APIs; existing Sarvam users can also apply
offers.how_to_claim: Apply with the form on the Sarvam Startup Program page.
offers.caveats: Participants must display "Powered by Sarvam" in their product. Credit amounts are not published and depend on use case, stage and scale. Unused credits do not roll over after the 6 to 12 month term.

offers.name: NVIDIA NIM free API access
offers.value: Free NIM API endpoints at build.nvidia.com for prototyping, plus self-hosted NIM microservices for development and testing on up to 16 GPUs
offers.summary: NVIDIA NIM is NVIDIA's set of hosted and self-hostable inference endpoints for leading AI models. Members of the free NVIDIA Developer Program get free access to NIM API endpoints at build.nvidia.com for prototyping, plus downloadable NIM microservices for research and testing on up to 16 GPUs.
offers.who_qualifies: Members of the free NVIDIA Developer Program, for prototyping, research, development and testing
offers.how_to_claim: Join the free NVIDIA Developer Program, open build.nvidia.com, pick a model and click Get API Key
offers.caveats: Free access is for prototyping, research, development and testing only; production use needs an NVIDIA AI Enterprise license. Hosted API catalog endpoints are a trial experience with rate limits that vary by model. Self-hosted NIM under the Developer Program is licensed for up to 16 GPUs.

offers.name: Clawifi Free plan
offers.value: 1,000 credits a month
offers.summary: Clawifi is a web access API for AI agents that searches, fetches and crawls pages over MCP, a Python SDK or plain HTTP, returning only the passages that answer a question. The Free plan gives 1,000 credits a month, where most calls cost 1 credit.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who signs up
offers.how_to_claim: pip install clawifi, then clawifi signup with an email to get an API key
offers.caveats: Public beta; 2 requests at once on the Free plan; browser renders cost 3 credits and research 30 to 300

offers.name: BeatAPI free models
offers.value: Three free text models, listed below. Free model IDs: glm-5.3-flash-free, deepseek-v4.1-flash-free, hy4-flash-free. Any key can call them if its group reaches the free group, including the default, including on a zero balance.
offers.summary: BeatAPI is a third-party model gateway. Free calls work on three text model IDs ending in -free (glm-5.3-flash-free, deepseek-v4.1-flash-free and hy4-flash-free), including on a zero balance.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone with a BeatAPI account and API key; no top-up needed
offers.how_to_claim: Create a BeatAPI account, generate an API key and call a free model id: glm-5.3-flash-free, deepseek-v4.1-flash-free or hy4-flash-free.
offers.caveats: Three free text models only. Free JEV IDs retired 2026-11-05. Rate limited (1 rpm before top-up, 10 after). Free access can be withdrawn anytime. No free image or video models.

offers.name: Agent Droplets free trial
offers.value: $5 in credit for Agent Droplets for new customers
offers.summary: DigitalOcean is a developer cloud for virtual servers, managed databases, Kubernetes, GPUs and AI inference. The Agent Droplets free trial gives new customers $5 in credit to run AI agents in isolated microVMs, with inference on DigitalOcean-hosted open models, storage and tool access.
offers.who_qualifies: New DigitalOcean customers only
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up for a new DigitalOcean account and start the Agent Droplets free trial
offers.caveats: New customers only; existing customers start on a paid plan. The credit covers inference on DigitalOcean-hosted models such as Kimi K3 and GLM 5.3; frontier models like Claude and GPT bill at list price. Once the $5 is used up, usage continues at list price unless you stop it. Official page does not state whether a card is required.

offers.name: Baseten AI Startup Program
offers.value: Up to $25,000 for Dedicated Deployments or Training, plus up to $2,500 for Model APIs
offers.summary: Baseten is a cloud platform for deploying, running and training AI models. Its startup program gives up to $25,000 in credits for Dedicated Inference or Training and up to $2,500 for Model APIs, plus support, events and go-to-market help.
offers.who_qualifies: AI-first startups (AI core to the product), Pre-Seed to Series A or no funding, founded within about 5 years, never had Baseten credits
offers.how_to_claim: Apply on the startup program page
offers.caveats: Application required. Amounts are up to figures; the base amount is not stated. Credits expire 6 months after the grant date. The company domain must not have been on a paid Baseten plan within 31 days of applying. The form allows No Funding as well as Pre-Seed to Series A.

offers.name: OpenAI startup credits
offers.value: Free OpenAI API credits (amount not published)
offers.summary: OpenAI makes the GPT models and sells access to them through its API. Startups backed by its partner VCs can get free API credits, possible rate limit upgrades, time with solutions engineers and events.
offers.who_qualifies: Portfolio companies of OpenAI partner VCs, such as Thrive Capital, Sequoia, a16z, Kleiner Perkins and Conviction
offers.how_to_claim: Ask your VC for a unique referral code, then apply on the startups page
offers.caveats: No credit amount is published. You need a referral code from a partner VC, so it is not open to direct applicants. Usage switches to standard billing when the credits run out.

offers.name: AssemblyAI Startup Program
offers.value: 12 months of recurring free credits (amount not stated) plus discounted startup pricing
offers.summary: AssemblyAI sells speech AI APIs that turn live or recorded audio into text. Its startup program gives 12 months of recurring free credits on Speech-to-text, Streaming speech-to-text and Dictation, plus discounted pricing, forward deployed engineer help and co-marketing.
offers.who_qualifies: Bootstrapped through Series A, building with voice or audio, launching within 6 months
offers.how_to_claim: Apply on the startup program page; applications are reviewed within one week
offers.caveats: The credit amount is not published. Discounted pricing does not apply to LLM Gateway. Applications are reviewed within one week.

offers.name: Sentry for Startups
offers.value: Up to $5,000 in Sentry credits plus priority support
offers.summary: Sentry is an error tracking and performance monitoring tool for developers. Its startup program gives up to $5,000 in Sentry credits and priority support.
offers.who_qualifies: Founded in the last 2 years, raised under $5M from VCs, and not already paying for Sentry
offers.how_to_claim: Create a free Sentry account, then apply with your org slug on the startups page
offers.caveats: Only for companies founded in the last 2 years with under $5M raised from VCs that are not already paying Sentry customers. Needs a free Sentry account and org slug to apply. Base amount not stated, $5,000 is the maximum. Credits expire 12 months after joining the program.

offers.name: Render for Startups
offers.value: $500 to $100K in Render credits by tier
offers.summary: Render is a cloud hosting platform for web apps, APIs, databases and background workers. Its startup program gives platform credits by tier: $500 Founder, $2,500 or $5K Build via partners, $10K or $25K Scale via top VCs, and $100K for the AI tier.
offers.who_qualifies: New Render customers, Series A or earlier, raised under $50M, under 4 years old (Scale tier under 5). Founder tier needs at least $25K seed funding; Build, Scale and AI tiers only through enrolled partners or VCs
offers.how_to_claim: Create a Render account, then apply on the startups page
offers.caveats: Even the lowest tier ($500) needs at least $25K in seed funding. Higher tiers only through an enrolled partner or VC. You need a Render account before applying. Credits are valid 1 year from approval.

offers.name: Together AI Startup Accelerator
offers.value: Up to $15K, $30K or $50K in platform credits by funding tier, plus forward deployed engineering hours
offers.summary: Together AI is a cloud for running, fine-tuning and training open-source AI models on GPUs. Its accelerator gives selected startups platform credits for serverless inference, dedicated endpoints, fine-tuning and instant clusters, plus 3 to 10 hours of forward deployed engineering.

offers.how_to_claim: Apply on the accelerator page
offers.caveats: Selection-based, not automatic. Credits do not apply to Reserved GPU Clusters. Most early teams fit the Build tier (up to $15K). Credit expiry not stated.

offers.name: Perch AI free Starter plan
offers.value: 20,000 PT of hosted usage each month (1 PT = $0.001, so up to $20), no card needed
offers.summary: Perch AI's free Starter plan gives a monthly hosted-usage allowance and a rotating set of free models. The official starter page currently lists DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and GLM 5.3 Flash, plus Qwen 3.8 Max until November 20, 2026, at noon Eastern.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone with a free Perch AI account; no credit card required
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up for Perch AI and choose the free Starter plan; it covers Web, Desktop and CLI
offers.caveats: The Starter Data Program is on by default and lets Perch turn deidentified usage into AI training data it can license; you can turn it off in Settings > Privacy. No direct API access. The free model lineup rotates.

offers.name: Keiki for Startups
offers.value: $500 in platform credit plus a free iMessage line for one month
offers.summary: Keiki's startup program: $500 toward AI replies, email and agent tools on its agent platform, your own iMessage number with the first month free, and founder support.
offers.who_qualifies: Companies founded within the last 10 years with a live website for a software product; bootstrapped or venture-backed, accelerator alumni especially welcome
offers.how_to_claim: Apply on the Keiki for Startups page; the team reviews and replies by email
offers.caveats: No deadline set yet. The iMessage line is free for the first month only.

offers.name: Deepgram Startup Program
offers.value: Up to $100,000 in Deepgram credits over 12 months; direct applicants start at $1,000
offers.summary: Deepgram credits for its speech-to-text, text-to-speech and Voice Agent APIs, plus invite-only events, engineering support groups and the Deepgram startup community.
offers.who_qualifies: AI builders or early-stage startups in production or launching in the next 6 months, committed to building and engaging with the Deepgram community
offers.how_to_claim: Create a Deepgram account and apply on the program page with your Project ID; replies usually within a week, credits land in your console 24 to 48 hours after acceptance
offers.expiry: ongoing (each credit grant expires 12 months from issue)
offers.caveats: Direct applicants start at $1,000; tiers up to $100,000 open up as your usage grows. Partner VCs and accelerators may list bigger offers on their perks pages. Applications are reviewed case by case.

offers.name: Claude Security launch credits
offers.value: Up to $25,000 in promotional credits for Claude Security usage per month, for two consecutive months
offers.summary: Claude Security is Anthropic's AI code scanner that continuously watches your repositories for vulnerabilities, tracks findings until fixed and suggests patches. Eligible Claude Enterprise organizations get up to $25,000 a month in free usage credits for two months.
offers.who_qualifies: Claude Enterprise organizations, including Claude Enterprise purchased through AWS Marketplace
offers.how_to_claim: No sign-up needed. Credits apply automatically to usage in the new Claude Security experience. Existing Enterprise orgs started October 21, 2026; new Enterprise orgs start on their signup day.
offers.caveats: Requires a Claude Enterprise plan with premium seats and usage credits enabled. Unused credits do not carry over month to month. Offer ends December 31, 2026, so orgs signing up after November 1 get less than two full months. Only applies to projects in the new experience.

offers.name: InstaBox Free plan
offers.value: 1 free cloud machine (4 vCPU / 8 GiB) with 20 GiB disk, 5 snapshots and 100 GiB egress a month
offers.summary: InstaBox gives AI agents their own persistent Linux cloud machines with Docker, snapshots, public HTTPS ports and pause and resume. Its Free plan includes one 4 vCPU / 8 GiB machine with a 20 GiB disk, 5 snapshots and 100 GiB egress a month, auto-paused after 30 idle minutes.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up at instabox.sh, or run npx instabox@latest sh to sign in and start a machine
offers.caveats: Free machines pause after 30 idle minutes

offers.name: MiniMax M3.1 Flash free on AnyRouter
offers.headline_note: on Go plan, no daily cap
offers.value: Free MiniMax M3.1 Flash API calls ($0 input and output) on AnyRouter's Go plan and higher, no daily cap
offers.summary: AnyRouter is an LLM router with one OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API in front of hundreds of models. It serves MiniMax M3.1 Flash, a 1M-context coding and agent model, free on the Go plan and higher with no daily cap.
offers.who_qualifies: AnyRouter users on Go or a higher plan. Go costs $2 a month, or is free when you donate one valid unique provider key. Free plan only gets a 5-request lifetime trial on free models
offers.how_to_claim: Sign in to AnyRouter, get on Go (subscribe for $2 a month or donate one provider key), then call the model id minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash:free through its OpenAI-compatible API
offers.caveats: AnyRouter is a third-party model router, not MiniMax itself. Since November 1, 2026 the Free plan only gets a 5-request lifetime trial on free models; ongoing free use needs Go, which is $2 a month ($2.63 with the processing fee) unless you donate one valid, unique provider key. Free-model requests are limited to 150 a minute on Go (60 with a donated key) and 400 on Pro and higher. Use the :free model id to pin the free route. No end date set; AnyRouter says it will announce any price change on its blog.

offers.name: Reflection Beam free on AI Gateway
offers.value: Reflection Beam 1.0 free when serviced by Reflection (reflection/beam or reflection/beam-free): $0 input and output, 1M-token context
offers.summary: Vercel AI Gateway serves Reflection AI's Beam 1.0 coding and agent model for free when the request is serviced by Reflection, with a 1M-token context. The 16 October 2026 changelog says this lasts for a limited time during the launch period, with no published end date. The live model page still lists the Reflection route as free.
offers.who_qualifies: Anyone who can create a Vercel AI Gateway API key. The official pages list no further eligibility limits.
offers.how_to_claim: Create an AI Gateway API key at https://vercel.com/ai-gateway/models/beam and call reflection/beam (optionally pinned to the reflection provider) or reflection/beam-free.
offers.caveats: Free only on the Reflection provider. Baseten, Together AI and Nebius routes are paid. reflection/beam will switch to paid pricing when the free period ends; reflection/beam-free will stop serving. No end date is published. The model playground also mentions a separate $5 AI Gateway credit every 30 days for users who have not made a payment; that is not this offer. Use is subject to Reflection's terms and privacy policy.

offers.name: Oracle Startup Growth Engine
offers.value: $5,000 to $60,000 in OCI Universal Credits, plus possible funding for one year of Level 1 OPN membership
offers.summary: Oracle's program for startups building on OCI: Universal Credits, with possible account and engineer support, a year of Oracle PartnerNetwork membership and Oracle Cloud Marketplace access.
offers.who_qualifies: Legally registered technology companies building digital products that intend to deploy workloads on OCI, in countries Oracle designates; public entities and applicants with sanctions, financial-crime or reputational risk are not eligible
offers.how_to_claim: Apply through the application form on the Oracle Startup Growth Engine page
offers.expiry: ongoing (credits last 12 months from when they are made available)
offers.caveats: Credit amount and every other benefit are at Oracle's discretion and not guaranteed. Credits are OCI-only, non-transferable and have no cash value; once used up, the tenancy moves to pay-as-you-go. Oracle's terms do not require venture backing. Full terms: https://www.oracle.com/europe/artificial-intelligence/startup-growth-engine/terms/

offers.name: Tavily for Startups
offers.value: 100k free API credits for 6 months, plus hands-on support and GTM opportunities
offers.summary: Tavily is a search API built for AI agents. Its official launch post for Tavily for Startups says early-stage, VC-backed teams get 100k free API credits plus engineering support and access to the Tavily x Nebius founder and investor network.
offers.who_qualifies: Early-stage, VC-backed startups building AI agents or LLMs, typically pre-seed to Series A
offers.how_to_claim: Apply on the startups page
offers.caveats: VC-backed startups only; credits last 6 months; rolling review.

offers.name: Google Antigravity for Science
offers.value: Highest Google Antigravity usage tier with Gemini 4 Argon, free for 6 months, for up to 10,000 selected scientists
offers.summary: Google Antigravity is Google's AI coding agent app. Google is giving up to 10,000 selected scientists its highest Antigravity usage tier, including the Gemini 4 Argon model, free of charge for 6 months.
offers.who_qualifies: Researchers doing non-commercial research with an active affiliation at a university, degree-granting institution, nonprofit research institute or national laboratory, selected on credentials and research impact
offers.how_to_claim: Apply via the form on the Antigravity science page with an institutional email, a public lab page and an ORCID or Google Scholar profile; onboarding is rolling
offers.caveats: Selection based: as of November 9, 2026 Google had over 27,000 applications and had granted access to the first 3,000 scientists; it onboards cohorts and only contacts selected applicants. Needs a valid ORCID iD or Google Scholar profile. Access is to the individual Antigravity service, not an institutional subscription. The science page says free of charge; the 6-month window is stated on the linked official application form.

offers.name: Monthly API credits for Claude Max and Team plans
offers.value: Max $100/mo; Ultra $200/mo; Team $20 per Standard seat and $100 per Premium seat, pooled and capped at $500/mo
offers.summary: Max, Ultra and Team subscribers get a monthly Claude API balance to build their own apps and agents.
offers.who_qualifies: Active Max, Ultra or Team subscribers after 7 days on the plan; Free, Pro and Enterprise not eligible
offers.how_to_claim: On claude.ai go to Settings > Billing (Max or Ultra subscriber; Team: Organization settings > Billing), choose Link organization, pick a Console org
offers.expiry: ongoing (credits expire at the end of each billing cycle)
offers.caveats: No rollover. Team credit is pooled from $20 per Standard seat and $100 per Premium seat and capped at $500/mo, so smaller teams get less. Comes with the Max or Team plan; not part of Claude Startups. Does not cover interactive Claude Code, extra usage, or Bedrock, Vertex, or Foundry. Only one Console org can be linked.

offers.name: X API free credit incentives

offers.summary: Bonus credits for new X API buyers, plus xAI API credits back on X API spend.
offers.who_qualifies: New X API pay-per-use customers
offers.how_to_claim: Save a card and buy credits in the Developer Console
offers.caveats: Requires a paid purchase, so this is not purely free.

offers.name: PostHog for Startups
offers.value: $50,000 in PostHog credits for 12 months, plus about $12,000 in partner perks
offers.summary: $50k of PostHog credit for a year for young startups.

offers.how_to_claim: Sign up to a paid PostHog plan (you pay only for usage), then apply from an account on your company email
offers.caveats: No priority support on the startup plan. Since Sept 14, 2026, credits can't be used on PostHog's own AI tools (PostHog AI, PostHog Desktop, the Slack app, Replay Vision, Inbox).

offers.name: Vercel for Startups
offers.value: Up to $30,000 in Flexible Commitment Amount, plus Enterprise-tier access
offers.summary: Credits toward Vercel Enterprise for startups, with startup-focused support.
offers.who_qualifies: Eligible startups (criteria not stated on the page)
offers.how_to_claim: Contact the Startups Team from the program page
offers.caveats: Eligibility criteria not stated on the public page. Value is a commitment amount, not cash.

offers.name: MiniMax Code daily check-in credits

offers.summary: MiniMax Code is MiniMax's AI coding and work agent for desktop and CLI. Checking in daily earns free points (up to 4,000 a week) that can be spent on coding, research and multimodal tasks across its models.
offers.who_qualifies: Any MiniMax Code user
offers.how_to_claim: Open the MiniMax Code app and complete the daily check-in (or use /checkin in the CLI)
offers.caveats: Check-in points expire 30 days after they are credited.

offers.name: Databricks Genie One free usage

offers.caveats: Genie Code is not included (150 free DBUs per user per month, then billed at a 25% promo discount). Genie compute is billed separately.

offers.summary: Neon Postgres credits for startups, from $1k for bootstrappers to $200k for funded teams.

offers.how_to_claim: Apply on the page
offers.caveats: Existing users can apply. Exact amount depends on stage.

offers.name: Microsoft for Startups

offers.summary: Azure credits plus AI tools and dev resources for startups.
offers.who_qualifies: Startups (criteria not stated on the page)

offers.how_to_claim: Apply with your GitHub profile and repos
offers.caveats: Amount scales with your OSS contribution.

offers.name: MongoDB for Startups

offers.summary: Tiered Atlas credits and embedding tokens for startups at any stage.

Startups accepted in the past may receive top-up credits, awarded case by case.
offers.how_to_claim: Apply on the page
offers.caveats: Credit amount is up to $15,000 and depends on stage and investment partner. Agencies and development shops are not eligible. You can only receive the maximum credit offer once; past members may get top-up credits case by case. Atlas credits: six months for $500 credits and 12 months for credits above $500, from the date you activate the promo code.

offers.name: ElevenLabs Startup Grants
offers.value: 33,000,000 characters for 12 months (more than $5,500 in value)
offers.summary: A year of voice AI usage for early startups building with ElevenLabs.
offers.who_qualifies: Startups under 25 employees with a monetized product use case; no agencies, consultancies, or SMBs; not existing enterprise customers
offers.how_to_claim: Apply on the grants page
offers.caveats: Rolling applications.

offers.name: Pinecone for Startups
offers.value: Free Standard Tier and Pro Support, plus usage credits and discounts (amounts not stated)
offers.summary: Free Standard tier and support on Pinecone's vector database for early startups.
offers.who_qualifies: Fewer than 100 employees, Series A or earlier
offers.how_to_claim: Join via the program page
offers.caveats: Credit and discount amounts not stated.

offers.value: First year 100% free (Growth plan, up to 100M events/mo, $60,000 value); year two 40% off
offers.summary: A free year of Amplitude analytics for small startups.

offers.how_to_claim: Create an account; you are prompted to apply
offers.caveats: Year two is 40% off the annual Plus plan, or you can drop to the free 2M events a month plan. YC companies have a separate deal on Bookface.

offers.name: Mixpanel for Startups
offers.value: One year free, worth $145,000 (1B events, 1M Session Replays)
offers.summary: A free year of Mixpanel's full suite for startups.
offers.who_qualifies: Startups incorporated less than 5 years ago that have raised no more than $8M in total, have not redeemed other Mixpanel offers and have never been on a paid plan
offers.how_to_claim: Join via the startups page
offers.caveats: One year only, then move to Free, Growth or Enterprise. You must start sending data within 90 days of acceptance or you are removed from the program and can't rejoin. Not for companies that have been on a paid Mixpanel plan.

offers.name: Linear startup program
offers.value: Get up to 6 months of Linear free through the startup program. Startups affiliated with a partner receive free access to Linear's Business plan.
offers.summary: Free Linear Business for startups backed by a Linear partner, for up to 6 months.
offers.who_qualifies: Non-paying users under 50 employees affiliated with an official Linear partner
offers.how_to_claim: Redeem through your partner's dedicated link
offers.caveats: Partner affiliation required (an official Linear partner VC, accelerator or community). Only for non-paying Linear users with fewer than 50 employees. The official page description says up to 6 months of Linear free. The FAQ does not state a length in the body.

offers.name: Free GitHub Copilot Pro for maintainers and teachers

offers.summary: Copilot Pro at no cost for popular OSS maintainers and teachers.

offers.how_to_claim: Check eligibility in Copilot settings

offers.name: Algolia Startup Program
offers.value: $10,000 in Algolia credits, valid 12 months
offers.summary: $10k of search credits for a year for new Algolia users.
offers.who_qualifies: New Algolia customers under 7 years old with under $15M raised
offers.how_to_claim: Apply on the program page
offers.caveats: Not for previous or existing paid Algolia customers or anyone who used another coupon.

offers.name: Google Cloud Free Trial
offers.value: $300 Welcome credit valid for 90 days for new customers, plus Free Tier monthly usage on 20+ products

The credit can't pay for Gemini API in AI Studio or third-party partner models offered as a managed API, and for signups or upgrades on or after November 16, 2026 it can't pay for Gemini platform (formerly Vertex AI) services either.
offers.who_qualifies: New users who have never been a paying user of Google Cloud, Google Maps Platform or Firebase, and have not previously signed up for the Free Trial.
offers.how_to_claim: Sign up for the Google Cloud Free Trial. You must provide a credit card or other valid payment method, and in some countries verify a bank account. After identity and payment verification, the 90-day trial starts with $300 Welcome credit.
offers.caveats: From November 16, 2026, the $300 credit cannot pay for Gemini platform (formerly known as Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Vertex AI) services if you sign up for a free trial or upgrade to a paid account on or after that date. The credit also cannot pay for Gemini API in AI Studio, or for generative AI partner models offered as a managed API. During the Free Trial you cannot add GPUs, use Marketplace, request quota increases, create VM instances based on Windows Server images, or create Google Cloud VMware Engine resources. If you do not upgrade before 90 days pass or the credit is spent, resources are stopped and a 30-day grace period begins. Unused credit still expires 90 days from signup even if you upgrade earlier.

offers.name: Exa Startup and Education Grants
offers.value: Up to $1,000 in free credits
offers.summary: Exa offers up to $1k of search credits to startups and education projects.

offers.how_to_claim: Contact Exa via the pricing page
offers.caveats: Criteria not stated. You apply by contacting the team from the pricing page. Exa also runs a separate Startup Program at exa.ai/startups.

offers.name: Modal for Startups
offers.value: Free credits (amount not stated). Credits last 1 year and cannot be reinstated if they expire.

offers.how_to_claim: Apply on the startups page
offers.caveats: One-time grant per tier. Amount not stated.

offers.name: Stripe Atlas product credits

The $500 Treasury reward requires opening a Stripe Treasury business account within 7 days of incorporation (terms at https://docs.stripe.com/atlas/stripe-treasury-offer). The extra Treasury spend bonus ($1,500 for C-Corps, $1,000 for LLCs, after spending $5,000 within 90 days) is listed in Stripe's Atlas perks partners article (https://support.stripe.com/questions/stripe-atlas-perks-partners), not on the main Atlas page.

offers.name: Runpod Startup Program - Starter Tier
offers.value: Starter: $1,000 in free credits (under $1M raised). Venture: $5,000 for verified-VC portfolio companies (under $5M raised). Growth Track: bonus credits on commit ($10k on $25k, $25k on $50k)

A separate Venture tier gives $5,000 to portfolio companies of a verified VC that raised under $5M. The Growth Track is a deposit bonus ($10k on a $25k commit, $25k on a $50k commit), not free credit.

offers.name: AWS Activate Credits
offers.value: Founders: up to $5,000 (start with $1,000). Portfolio: up to $200,000. AI startups: $200,000+ by invite

offers.name: Cloudflare for Startups

Until then, existing startups have Workers AI caps of $2,500 (Tier 3), $10,000 (Tier 2) and $50,000 (Tier 1). R2 is capped at $10,000. AI Gateway is temporarily not covered. The qualify list also says funded within the last 12 months, which sits next to Tier 3 (bootstrapped or under $1M, no minimum funding).

offers.how_to_claim: Be on Starter with a card on file, then apply
